Virtual base class that disables copying and assignment for derived classes. It provides a protected default constructor and destructor, and declares (but does not define) a private copy constructor and copy-assignment operator, making them inaccessible and thus preventing copying. Intended to be inherited (likely virtually, per the comment) by classes that must be non-copyable.

A UTF-8–backed string class used by the Adobe DNG SDK. It stores text as UTF-8 in an internal dng_memory_data buffer and provides conversion to/from ASCII, UTF-8, UTF-16, and system encodings, plus utilities for comparison, searching, trimming, case changes, line-ending normalization, and numeric list normalization. Memory ownership is internal; instances manage their own storage. Construction and copying follow value semantics via constructors, assignment, and destructor.

Container class managing a dynamic list of dng_string objects. Holds a count, allocated capacity, and an array of pointers to dng_string. Provides indexing, allocation, insertion, append, contains, and clear operations. Copying is intentionally disabled via private copy constructor and assignment, implying unique ownership of contained strings. Details of memory management and dng_string are external to this header.

2D integer point with vertical (v) and horizontal (h) coordinates. Provides default and value constructors and equality/inequality operators. Used with free functions/operators in this header for addition, subtraction, and transpose. Values are int32 and arithmetic in free operators uses safe add/subtract helpers to avoid overflow.

2D point with real64 precision for vertical (v) and horizontal (h) coordinates. Constructible from doubles or from an integer dng_point. Supports equality/inequality and rounding to nearest int32 via Round(), which returns a dng_point. Free operators provide addition, subtraction, transpose, and distance squared operations in this header.

Axis-aligned integer rectangle with top (t), left (l), bottom (b), right (r) edges stored as int32. Provides constructors with overflow checks, dimension queries (W, H), corner accessors, size, and diagonal length. Utility and arithmetic free functions/operators for union, intersection, translation, transpose, scaling, and padding are declared in this header. Ownership/lifecycle is trivial (POD-like).

Axis-aligned rectangle with real64 coordinates for t, l, b, r. Provides floating-point geometry, conversions from integer rectangles, size/diagonal calculations, and rounding back to dng_rect. Trivial ownership; no special lifecycle requirements.

Represents a chromaticity coordinate in CIE xy space with double-precision components x and y. Provides default and parameterized constructors, clearing, validity checks (both x and y positive), and equality/inequality operators. Free inline operators provide vector add/subtract, scalar multiply, and dot product. Several inline factory functions yield standard illuminant white points (StdA, D50, D55, D65, D75). Conversion functions to/from XYZ are declared but defined elsewhere.

General-purpose 2D matrix class sized up to kMaxColorPlanes × kMaxColorPlanes, storing real64 elements with row/column counts. Supports identity setup, element access, comparisons, diagonal test, extrema queries, scaling and rounding. Serves as a base for fixed-size specializations (3×3, 4×3). Ownership: none indicated here. Construction details beyond declared ctors are in the implementation, not present in this header.
Fixed-size 3×3 matrix derived from dng_matrix. Provides constructors for full element initialization, diagonal initialization, or from a base dng_matrix.
Fixed-size 4×3 matrix derived from dng_matrix, intended for 4-channel color camera workflows. Constructors allow element-wise initialization or construction from a base dng_matrix.
General-purpose 1D vector up to kMaxColorPlanes elements of real64. Supports identity setup, element access, comparisons, extrema, scaling, rounding, and conversion to diagonal or column matrices.
Fixed-size 3-element vector derived from dng_vector, with constructors for element-wise initialization or from a base vector.
Fixed-size 4-element vector derived from dng_vector, with constructors for element-wise initialization or from a base vector.

Signed rational number type with 32-bit numerator and denominator. Provides validity checks (denominator non-zero), equality comparison, conversion to/from real64, and a method to reduce by a given factor. Numerator and denominator are public for direct access. Construction with default zeros or explicit values.

Unsigned rational number type with 32-bit numerator and denominator. Provides validity checks (denominator non-zero), equality comparison, conversion to/from real64, and a method to reduce by a given factor. Numerator and denominator are public for direct access. Construction with default zeros or explicit values.

Represents a color in terms of correlated color temperature (in Kelvin, via black body radiator model) and tint (green–magenta offset). Provides constructors from temperature/tint and from an xy chromaticity coordinate, accessors/mutators for temperature and tint, and conversion to/from dng_xy_coord. Implementation of Set_xy_coord and Get_xy_coord is not present in this header. real64 and dng_xy_coord are defined elsewhere.

Represents a calendar date and time (to whole seconds) with simple validation, parsing from EXIF date strings, and basic comparisons. Fields are public for direct access; Clear sets to invalid; IsValid enforces range checks.

Stores a time zone offset from GMT in minutes with range checks (±15 hours), helpers for setting via hours/minutes/seconds, and encoding to ISO 8601. Default constructs to invalid until set or cleared.

Aggregates a date/time, optional subseconds string, and an optional time zone. Provides parsing/encoding for ISO 8601 and IPTC date/time strings, validity checks, and mutators. Default construction yields an empty/invalid instance until set.
Tracks where and how a date/time value was stored in a file: a byte offset and the storage encoding format. Default construct is invalid; provides IsValid and accessor methods that throw if invalid.
Enumeration of on-disk date/time encodings used by the SDK: unknown, EXIF text, or 32-bit UNIX time in little- or big-endian byte order.

Fixed-size container for a 128-bit MD5 fingerprint. Provides equality tests, validity checks, conversion to/from hexadecimal UTF-8 strings, and a collapsed 32-bit hash. Used to represent strong hashes of image data.
Functor providing a strict-weak-order comparator for dng_fingerprint values based on lexicographic comparison of their raw bytes. Useful for ordered containers (e.g., std::map, std::set).
Incremental MD5 hasher that consumes bytes or C-strings and produces a dng_fingerprint result. Supports reset and exposes low-level MD5 transform helpers internally.

A write-only dng_stream that feeds bytes into an internal dng_md5_printer while tracking stream offset. Reading is unsupported and triggers an error. Provides Result() to retrieve the computed dng_fingerprint.

Abstract base class that serializes/deserializes primitive values and byte blocks with optional byte-order swapping and buffering. Provides random-access read/write, endian control, tag-sized value helpers, and conversion to contiguous memory. Backed by virtual DoRead/DoWrite/DoGetLength/DoSetLength for subclasses to implement storage (e.g., file, memory). Maintains a buffer, current position, length caching, and an optional abort sniffer. Construction may be via protected ctor (for subclasses) or a public ctor that initializes from an existing memory block.
RAII helper that temporarily forces a dng_stream to a specific endian mode (big-endian if bigEndian is true) and restores the previous swap/endian state on destruction.
RAII helper that sets a dng_stream to little-endian temporarily by constructing TempBigEndian with the inverse flag; restores prior endian state on destruction.
RAII helper that temporarily installs a dng_abort_sniffer on a dng_stream and restores the previous sniffer in its destructor. Prevents copying.
RAII guard that records a stream’s current read position on construction and restores it on destruction, ensuring non-destructive probing/peek operations. Copying is disabled.

RAII helper class that allocates and owns a small raw memory buffer using malloc/free. Provides typed accessors for common integral and floating types. Copy/assign are disabled. Allocate/Clear manage the buffer lifetime.

Abstract base class representing a large, aligned memory block used for images or similar buffers. Requires a dng_memory_allocator to allocate. Tracks logical size, pads physical size, aligns buffer pointer, and provides typed accessors. Copy/assign disabled.

Interface for allocating dng_memory_block instances. Implementations create blocks of the requested size and may manage alignment and underlying storage. Default global allocator instance is provided externally.

Memory-backed implementation of dng_stream that stores data in pages allocated via a provided dng_memory_allocator. Supports reading, writing, resizing (DoSetLength), and copying its contents to another stream. The class manages an internal list of dng_memory_block pages and tracks total length. Copy construction and assignment are disabled. Details of page management and allocator behavior are not present in this header.

Primary host/dispatcher class for the Adobe DNG SDK. It encapsulates SDK-wide configuration (allocator, abort sniffer, size preferences, crop factor, save options) and serves as the factory and execution entry-point for tasks and SDK object construction. Typical usage: instantiate (optionally with custom dng_memory_allocator and dng_abort_sniffer), adjust flags/sizes, then call factory methods to create SDK objects and PerformAreaTask for processing. Lifetime: allocator/sniffer pointers are not owned/destroyed by dng_host. Copying is disabled (private copy/assign).
Enumeration of thread priority levels used by the DNG SDK to gate sniffing/progress behavior. Includes explicit min/max aliases and a count sentinel.
RAII-style helper that temporarily sets the thread priority to minimum and restores it on destruction. Exact behavior is defined in its implementation; it stores a previous priority in fPriority.

Abstract base class for user-cancel checks and progress reporting. Hosts derive from this and implement Sniff (required) and optionally StartTask/EndTask/UpdateProgress. Maintains a dng_priority controlling sniff cadence. Static SniffForAbort provides a convenience abort check; ThreadSafe advertises concurrency support (default false).

RAII scope helper that announces a named subtask to a dng_abort_sniffer on construction (StartTask) and automatically ends it on destruction (EndTask). Provides convenience methods to sniff for abort and report progress, including integer-based progress. Non-copyable.

A class representing a rectangular pixel buffer plus metadata describing its pixel geometry (area, plane range, steps, pixel type/size) and access permissions. Provides typed and untyped pixel accessors, region fill/copy/repeat operations, flipping, shifting, equality and difference checks. Pixel type must match the accessor used (e.g., ttShort for uint16). Construction supports various planar configurations. Destruction and ownership of fData are not described here; usage details beyond interface are unknown in this header.
direct_api_constructors: dng_pixel_buffer(const dng_rect &area, uint32 plane, uint32 planes, uint32 pixelType, uint32 planarConfiguration, void *data)

objects.description: RAII-style helper that represents access to a rectangular tile of image pixels. It derives from dng_pixel_buffer and is acquired via image-specific mechanisms to read or write tiles. Holds a reference to the source dng_image and optional reference data pointer for client use. Construction is protected; created by derived classes dng_const_tile_buffer and dng_dirty_tile_buffer. Copy/assign disabled.
Concrete RAII wrapper for acquiring a read-only (constant) tile from a dng_image. It ensures acquisition on construction and release on destruction via dng_tile_buffer interface.
Concrete RAII wrapper for acquiring a writable (dirty) tile from a dng_image. On destruction releases the tile and commits writes through dng_tile_buffer’s mechanisms.

Abstract base class representing an image in the DNG SDK. Stores bounds, plane count, and pixel type, and provides APIs for tiled access, copying, edge handling, trimming, rotation, and setting constants. Concrete storage/implementation supplied by derived classes (e.g., dng_simple_image, not defined here). Includes nested enum edge_option controlling padding behavior when accessing outside bounds.

Concrete dng_image subclass that stores pixels in an internal dng_pixel_buffer with allocator-backed memory. Provides simple operations: setting pixel type, trimming to bounds without reallocating, and rotating by orientation. Exposes its pixel buffer for direct processing and overrides AcquireTileBuffer for tile access. Construction requires bounds, plane count, pixel type, and a memory allocator. Destruction and cloning are virtual as per base class. Full behavior details depend on definitions in included headers; some specifics are not shown here.
Holds image resolution metadata: X and Y resolution as unsigned rationals and the resolution unit. Provides a default constructor; no other behavior is defined here.
Abstract base class representing a TIFF tag entry. Stores tag code, data type, element count, and provides Size and pure virtual Put for writing to a stream. Copy/assign disabled.
Concrete TIFF tag that writes raw data from a pointer. Holds a type-specific pointer and count; Put writes the tag and its data.
TIFF tag wrapper for ASCII or possibly UTF-8 strings, stores a dng_string and writes it via Put. Constructor can force ASCII.
TIFF tag for EXIF/GPS encoded text fields. Stores original text and a UTF-16 buffer for writing as required by EXIF specs.
Helper tag for a single 8-bit unsigned value (ttByte). Stores internal value buffer and exposes Set.
Tag that references an external array of uint8 values to write as ttByte data.
Helper tag for a single 16-bit unsigned short (ttShort).
Tag referencing an array of signed 16-bit values (ttSShort).
Tag referencing an array of unsigned 16-bit shorts (ttShort).
Helper tag for a single 32-bit unsigned long (ttLong).
Tag referencing an array of 32-bit unsigned values (ttLong).
Helper tag for a single unsigned rational (ttRational). Keeps an internal const dng_urational value.
Tag referencing an array of unsigned rationals (ttRational).
Helper tag for a single signed rational (ttSRational).
Tag referencing an array of signed rationals (ttSRational).
Helper tag for a single 64-bit float (ttDouble).
Writes a color transform matrix as an array of signed rationals. Stores entries internally and uses tag_srational_ptr behavior.
TIFF tag wrapper for ICC profile blobs. Holds a pointer/size to the profile data for writing into the file.
Encodes the CFA pattern tag (ttUndefined) with rows, cols, and pattern bytes as specified by EXIF. Put writes the structured payload.
Helper to write EXIF date/time strings (YYYY:MM:DD HH:MM:SS\0). Stores a 20-byte buffer and uses tag_data_ptr.
Represents an IPTC/NAA data block tag. Holds pointer and length; Put writes the data payload with proper tag formatting.
Tag wrapper for embedding XMP packet data in TIFF/DNG. Manages an internal buffer that backs the uint8 pointer base class.
Aggregates and writes a TIFF IFD (directory). Holds up to 100 tag pointers, an optional chain offset, and can write itself with different offset bases.

Builds and manages the set of fundamental TIFF tags for an image (dimensions, tiling/strips, compression, sample formats, etc.), and exposes setters for tile offsets and byte counts used during writing.
Builds and manages EXIF and GPS IFDs and related tags/links. Provides methods to size, locate link offsets, and write both IFDs into a stream.
Helper to serialize a DNG Extended Color Profile into TIFF IFD form. Inherits privately from dng_tiff_directory and writes profile content.
Represents the DNG NoiseProfile tag content as an array of doubles for each color plane (slope, intercept pairs).
Enumeration controlling which subset of metadata to include when writing files (e.g., copyright only, all, exclude camera or location info).
High-level writer for TIFF and DNG images. Provides APIs to write images, previews, metadata, and to manage buffering, tiling, compression predictors, and byte order during output.

Row-interleaving image adapter that derives from dng_image. It wraps a referenced dng_image (fImage) and exposes an image whose rows are interleaved by a fixed factor (fFactor). DoGet/DoPut map between the interleaved representation and the underlying image using MapRow. Construction requires a target dng_image and the interleave factor. Lifetime is tied to the referenced image, which must outlive this adapter.

Reader utility class responsible for reading image tiles/strips from a DNG stream into a dng_image. Supports uncompressed, baseline JPEG, and lossless JPEG paths; handles byte-swapping and predictor decoding. Contains an internal JPEG tables buffer and a constant kImageBufferSize for copy buffers. Designed for subclassing to override specific decoding behaviors. Ownership: no explicit owners; constructed and used by client code; friends with dng_read_tiles_task (defined elsewhere).

Top-level class encapsulating parsed information about a DNG (Digital Negative) file, including file endianness, TIFF magic, EXIF/shared metadata, and collections of IFDs (main, sub-IFDs, chained IFDs). Provides parsing, post-parse validation, and helper routines for tags, IFDs, maker notes, and private data. Copying is disabled; use by constructing, calling Parse and PostParse, and then inspecting fields or IsValidDNG. Destruction is virtual for polymorphic use.

Concrete container class for parsing and holding EXIF tags from image metadata. Provides many public fields mirroring standard EXIF, GPS, and related TIFF/interop tags, plus utilities to parse, normalize, and set key values (exposure, aperture, timestamps). Lifecycle: default-construct, optionally Clone, fill via ParseTag/PostParse or setters, and destroy via virtual destructor. Parsing cooperates with dng_stream/dng_shared/dng_host (defined elsewhere).

Class representing IPTC metadata embedded in a DNG file. Holds common IPTC fields (title, urgency, categories, keywords, instructions, creation times, creators, location, credit/source/copyright, description). Provides parsing from a raw IPTC block and serialization to a memory block. Two scoped enums (DataSet and CharSet) define IPTC dataset IDs and character set handling used internally. Details like memory management and stream behavior depend on other SDK types (e.g., dng_stream, dng_memory_allocator) not defined here.
Class representing a camera profile identifier: a name plus an optional fingerprint. Provides constructors, accessors, validity checks, and equality operators.

Primary container class for DNG camera color profile and calibration data, including matrices, hue/sat maps, tone curve, embed policy, copyright, and metadata flags. Provides parsing, validation, fingerprinting, and manipulation APIs. Constructed via default constructor; copy/move semantics follow compiler defaults (not specified here).
Concrete 1D transfer function implementing the sRGB electro‑optical transfer function (gamma encode) and its inverse. Provides Evaluate/EvaluateInverse and a static accessor for a shared instance.
Concrete 1D transfer function implementing a simple gamma 1.8 encoding curve and its inverse. Provides Evaluate/EvaluateInverse and a static accessor for a shared instance.
Concrete 1D transfer function implementing a simple gamma 2.2 encoding curve and its inverse. Provides Evaluate/EvaluateInverse and a static accessor for a shared instance.

Abstract base class representing a color space with linear transform matrices to/from a Profile Connection Space (PCS) and an associated gamma (transfer) function. Provides helpers for gamma encode/decode, monochrome detection, and optional ICC profile access. Construction details (matrices, profile data) are supplied by derived classes via protected setters.
Singleton derived color space implementing sRGB. Supplies sRGB gamma and an IEC61966‑2.1 ICC profile. Access via Get(); constructor is protected to enforce singleton.
Singleton derived color space implementing Adobe RGB (1998). Supplies gamma 1.8 transfer and the Adobe RGB ICC profile. Access via Get(); constructor is protected.
Singleton derived color space implementing ColorMatch RGB. Uses gamma 1.8 and provides the corresponding ICC profile. Access via Get(); constructor is protected.
Singleton derived color space implementing ProPhoto RGB. Uses gamma 1.8 and provides a ProPhoto ICC profile. Access via Get(); constructor is protected.

Singleton derived grayscale color space with gamma 1.8. Provides a simple grayscale ICC profile. Access via Get(); constructor is protected. Likely uses SetMonochrome in implementation to mark single‑channel.
Singleton derived grayscale color space with gamma 2.2. Provides a simple grayscale ICC profile. Access via Get(); constructor is protected.

Derived color space representing a placeholder or synthetic RGB space used internally. No gamma/profile overrides are declared here; behavior falls back to base where applicable. Access via Get(); constructor is protected.

objects.definition:
dng_matrix_3by3 MapWhiteMatrix (const dng_xy_coord &white1,
						   	const dng_xy_coord &white2);
objects.description: Function declaration returning a 3x3 matrix type. The underlying type dng_matrix_3by3 is referenced but not defined in this header; thus no custom type is defined here for it.

Class representing a complete color specification for converting between a camera’s native color space and Profile Connection Space (PCS), including white point handling and various calibration matrices. It owns calibration matrices, white point, and derived transforms. Construction requires a dng_negative and an optional dng_camera_profile; other details (lifecycle, invariants) are not specified in this header.

A table-based color correction class that maps normalized HSV coordinates to delta adjustments (hue shift in degrees, saturation scale, value scale). Stores a 3D grid in value–hue–saturation order, with constraints: hueDivisions >= 1, satDivisions >= 2, valDivisions >= 1. Provides dimension management, safe counting, read/write access to entries, and interpolation between two maps. Memory for entries is managed via an internal dng_ref_counted_block.
Per-entry delta parameters for the hue-sat map: hue shift (degrees), saturation scale, and value scale, all as 32-bit floats.

Represents an image orientation using Adobe’s internal encoding (0..7) with utilities to convert to/from TIFF orientation, query flips, and compose/invert orientations. Stores a uint32 code and exposes static constructors for common orientations. Methods FlipD/FlipH/FlipV, SetTIFF/GetTIFF, unary minus and addition are declared here but defined elsewhere.

Abstract base class for all preview types written into a DNG file. Holds common preview info (fInfo) and defines the interface to add TIFF tag sets and write preview data to a stream. Constructed only by derived classes (protected ctor).
Concrete preview that stores a rendered image for embedding as a DNG preview. Owns an image via AutoPtr and maintains an IFD for tag management. Non-copyable.
Concrete preview representing a JPEG-compressed preview image with related JPEG/TIFF parameters and compressed byte buffer. Provides helper to spool an Adobe-format thumbnail. Non-copyable.

Concrete preview that stores a raw mosaic-based preview image. Optionally carries OpcodeList2 blob to be associated with the preview and a compression quality setting. Maintains its own IFD. Non-copyable.
Concrete preview used for mask-type images (e.g., selection masks), with adjustable compression quality, owning an image and managing an IFD. Non-copyable.
Container/owner for a bounded list of previews. Manages up to kMaxDNGPreviews items via AutoPtr, tracks count, allows append and accessors.

objects.definition: typedef AutoPtr<dng_memory_block> dng_jpeg_image_tile_ptr;
objects.description: Alias for an AutoPtr managing a dng_memory_block, used to reference JPEG tile/strip data buffers. Acts as a smart pointer owning a block of memory that stores JPEG-compressed data.

Container for JPEG-compressed image data organized as tiles or strips within the DNG SDK. Stores image and tile dimensions, whether strips are used, optional shared JPEG tables, and an array of tile/strip data buffers. Provides helpers to query tiling and methods to encode an image and compute a digest. Construction/destruction details are not shown; fields suggest ownership of memory via AutoPtr and AutoArray.
Typedef for an 8-bit unsigned integer is referenced (uint8) but defined elsewhere (likely in dng_tag_types.h). Not defined here, so it should be ignored. No custom types are defined in this header.

A discrete 2D gain map storing per-sample scale factors (real32) over a grid with configurable spacing, origin, and number of color planes. Provides direct element access, interpolation, and stream serialization. Construction requires a memory allocator and grid/geometry parameters. Copying is disabled (private copy/assign).
direct_api_constructors: dng_gain_map::dng_gain_map(dng_memory_allocator &, const dng_point &, const dng_point_real64 &, const dng_point_real64 &, uint32)

objects.description: An inplace processing opcode that applies a dng_gain_map over a specified area. Supports construction from an area specification plus a gain map, or deserialization from a stream. Provides serialization, declares float buffer processing, computes effective bounds, and processes image data. Copying is disabled.

Class representing descriptive information and operations for color filter array (CFA) mosaic data in DNG files. It stores CFA pattern geometry and metadata (pattern size, per-plane colors, layout, and Bayer green split), plus sizes/aspect. It provides parsing hooks from a DNG stream, post-parse processing, utilities to determine scaling and output dimensions, and demosaicing interpolation methods (generic, fast, and chooser). Construction/destruction are virtual; usage requires collaborating types (dng_host, dng_stream, dng_info, dng_negative, dng_image, dng_point) defined elsewhere. Details like memory ownership of images are external to this class.

No custom types are defined in this header. The file only declares functions and relies on types defined in other headers (e.g., dng_stream, dng_string, dng_matrix, dng_vector, dng_date_time, dng_fingerprint) or primitive typedefs (e.g., uint32, uint16, uint8, real64, bool). As per instructions, referenced-but-not-defined types must be ignored.

Manages sensor linearization metadata for DNG files, including active/masked sensor areas, linearization table, black level patterns and per-row/column deltas, and per-plane white levels. Provides parsing from DNG metadata, post-parse adjustments, computation of black levels, and applying linearization to images. Construction/destruction are default; details of memory ownership for AutoPtr<dng_memory_block> follow AutoPtr semantics defined elsewhere.

Abstract base class for lens warp parameters. Holds common parameters (plane count and optical center) and declares the interface to evaluate radial/tangential warps and bounds. Implementations must provide plane propagation and warp evaluation. Used by warp opcodes to correct lens distortions.

Concrete warp parameters for a rectilinear (pinhole) camera model supporting both radial and tangential distortion. Stores up to kMaxColorPlanes sets of radial and tangential polynomial coefficients and implements evaluation and bounds methods.

Concrete warp parameters for a fisheye camera model (radial-only). Stores per-plane radial coefficients of an atan-based polynomial and implements evaluation and bounds methods. Tangential warp is effectively a NOP.

Opcode that applies rectilinear warp to an image using provided rectilinear parameters. Owns dng_warp_params_rectilinear and integrates with the DNG opcode pipeline (serialization, validation, application).
Opcode that applies fisheye radial warp using dng_warp_params_fisheye. Provides serialization, validation, and application hooks in the DNG opcode framework.
Holds parameters for a radially-symmetric vignette gain correction: gain = 1 + sum_{i=0..4} k_i * r^{2(i+1)} about an optical center. Provides validation/NOP checks and debugging dump.

In-place opcode that corrects radially-symmetric vignetting using dng_vignette_radial_params. Manages per-thread mask buffers and precomputed gain table; integrates with pipeline prepare/process stages.
Models sensor noise as N(x) = sqrt(scale*x + offset). Provides getters/setters and evaluation. Valid when scale > 0 and offset >= 0. Inherits dng_1d_function for function-like evaluation.

Holds one or N per-channel dng_noise_function instances describing sensor noise. Valid when size is 1 or equals the negative’s color plane count. Constructors and methods are declared here; definitions are external.

Aggregates and manages all embedded/sidecar metadata related to a negative: base orientation, EXIF, XMP (optional), IPTC, MakerNote, and related digests/flags. Provides APIs to synchronize and manipulate these blocks and to build EXIF blocks. Templates expose derived EXIF/XMP types via dynamic_cast.

Core object representing a DNG negative: holds raw/demosaiced images across processing stages, camera/processing parameters, profiles, and all related metadata. Provides parsing, building stage images, noise/profile controls, color calibration, digests, proxy conversion, transparency handling, and many getters/setters. Owns dng_metadata and various sub-objects via AutoPtr; constructed via Make(host) factory. Many methods are declared here and defined elsewhere.

One-dimensional tone function used to model a pre-exposure-compensation ramp based on noise floor, shadows, and highlight level. Provides Evaluate for mapping input tone to adjusted output using a straight segment with rounding and quadratic scale. Construction requires white, black, and minimum black inputs. Destruction/ownership are standard C++ class semantics; no special restrictions are stated.

One-dimensional exposure compensation curve parameterized by exposure (in stops) using a quadratic roll-off for highlights. Evaluate maps input tone to compensated output. Acts as a NOP when exposure is zero (via fIsNOP). Standard C++ object with no special ownership rules stated.

Built-in default ACR3 tone curve implementing a standard mapping and its inverse for Adobe Camera Raw 3. Provides static Get to access a shared instance as a dng_1d_function. No explicit constructor is exposed; likely singleton-style access via Get.

Gamma-encoding 1D function for a specified color space. Stores a reference to the color space and maps linear input to gamma-encoded output via Evaluate. Constructed with a dng_color_space reference; lifetime of referenced space must outlive this object.

Renderer that converts a dng_negative into a displayable dng_image. Holds configuration such as white point, exposure, shadows, tone curve, output color space, pixel type, and maximum output size. Construct with a host and negative; configure via setters; call Render() to produce an image. Non-copyable. Internally keeps an AutoPtr to a dng_spline_solver for profile tone curve; ownership managed by the class. Caller owns the returned dng_image pointer and must manage its lifetime per the SDK conventions.
Abstract base class for resampling kernels. Provides the extent (support radius) and an evaluation function of the kernel at a given x. Used by resampling code to compute weights.
Concrete resampling kernel implementing a bicubic filter. Provides Extent and Evaluate; also offers a static accessor Get() for a shared instance.

Helper that stores precomputed source coordinate mappings for 1D resampling. Uses an internal memory block to hold per-destination index coordinate data, with fixed-point subsample bits for fractional positions.

Precomputed 1D resampling weight tables for a given kernel and scale. Stores weights in both 32-bit float and 16-bit integer forms, with methods to query rows of weights for a given fractional position index.
Precomputed 2D resampling weight tables for separable kernels sampled on a 2D subsample grid. Provides accessors to float and int16 weight planes indexed by 2D fractional position.

Cubic spline solver and evaluator implementing dng_1d_function. It stores control point x/y pairs and computed slopes S, exposes methods to add points, solve for spline coefficients (slopes), test identity mapping, and evaluate the spline at a given x. Details of solving strategy are not shown here; behavior inferred from naming and members.

Abstract base class for 1D floating-point mapping functions with domain [0,1]. Provides virtual interface for evaluating the function and its inverse; default inverse uses numerical method. Destructor virtual; IsIdentity reports if mapping is identity. Implementations must define Evaluate and should ensure inputs are clamped/handled per their semantics.

Concrete identity implementation of dng_1d_function. Evaluate(x) returns x; EvaluateInverse(y) returns y; IsIdentity() true. Exposes a threadsafe singleton accessor Get() returning a const dng_1d_function reference.

Function object composing two dng_1d_function instances: y = f2(f1(x)). Holds references to the inner and outer functions. Evaluate applies composition; inverse attempts to solve for x; identity only if both are identity. Caller must ensure f1 range lies within [0,1] or values will be clipped.

Adapter that represents the inverse of another dng_1d_function. Holds a reference to the wrapped function. Evaluate(x) computes f^{-1}(x); EvaluateInverse(y) computes f(y). IsIdentity reflects whether wrapped function is identity. Behavior depends on wrapped function being invertible over domain/range.

A concrete class implementing a 1D float-to-float lookup table with linear interpolation over a fixed-size table (kTableSize = 4096). It holds an internal memory buffer and a pointer to table data, provides initialization from a dng_1d_function via an allocator (optionally sub-sampled), interpolation for inputs in [0,1], direct table access, and expansion to a 16-bit LUT. Copying is disabled (private copy constructor/assignment). Details of memory ownership are internal via AutoPtr<dng_memory_block>.

A mutual-exclusion lock class for thread synchronization in the DNG SDK. Provides Lock/Unlock and records a mutex name and an optional lock level for deadlock avoidance. Internally wraps a pthread_mutex_t when qDNGThreadSafe is enabled. Copying is disallowed. Lifetime management is manual; typical usage is via the RAII helpers dng_lock_mutex and dng_unlock_mutex. Details like recursive locking behavior and lock-level policy are inferred from member names; specifics are not fully documented here.
RAII helper that locks a dng_mutex in its constructor and unlocks it in its destructor, ensuring exception-safe locking. Holds a non-owning pointer to the target dng_mutex. Copying is disallowed.

RAII helper that temporarily unlocks a dng_mutex on construction and re-locks it on destruction. Useful for scoped release of a lock while preserving structured locking. Holds a non-owning pointer to the target dng_mutex. Copying is disallowed.

Condition variable wrapper used with dng_mutex for thread coordination. Provides Wait with optional timeout, Signal to wake one waiter, and Broadcast to wake all. Internally wraps pthread_cond_t when qDNGThreadSafe is enabled. Copying is disallowed. Only available when qDNGThreadSafe is defined.

Tile iterator class that walks over a rectangular area in tile-sized chunks. It can be constructed from an image plus an area, a tile size plus an area, or a specific tile rectangle plus an area. GetOneTile outputs successive tile rectangles covering the area. Internal paging fields track tile grid and progress. Details of dng_image, dng_rect, dng_point, and int32 are external to this header.

Reference-counted, malloc-backed memory block with copy-on-write semantics. Exposes typed accessors to the underlying byte buffer and tracks logical size. Internally stores a header (mutex, ref count, size) preceding the user buffer. Constructors allocate zero or specified size; copy and assignment share storage by incrementing ref count; EnsureWriteable makes a private copy when shared. Clear frees storage. Uses dng_mutex for thread-safe refcounting. Exact allocation/free and thread-safety details beyond interface are inferred from names and comments.

objects.description: Named enum representing standard JPEG marker byte values used when parsing JPEG streams.
Named enum representing CFA color codes per TIFF/EP. Provides identifiers for filter colors in a color filter array.
Named enum listing allowed color spaces for DNG preview images.

Opcode class deriving from dng_opcode that trims an image to a specified rectangle (fBounds). Provides constructors from bounds or stream, serialization, and Apply to perform trimming. Details of dng_opcode, dng_rect, and other referenced types are external to this header.

Describes a sub-area of an image, including rectangle bounds, a plane range (first plane and count), and row/column pitch for sub-sampling patterns. Provides serialization to/from dng_stream and intersection computation. Useful for scoping opcodes to specific planes or mosaic positions.

In-place opcode applying a 1D lookup-table mapping (16-bit table) to pixels within a specified area. Owns a memory block of table entries and records the count. Supports construction from explicit table data or deserialization from a stream, serialization, buffer type negotiation, and processing of the targeted area.

In-place opcode applying a 1D polynomial mapping to pixels within a specified area. Stores degree and double-precision coefficients (with precomputed float coefficients). Provides serialization, buffer type negotiation, modified bounds, and area processing.

In-place opcode applying a per-row additive delta to pixels within a specified area. Deltas are provided as a table of 32-bit floats stored in a memory block, with an optional scale factor. Supports construction from a table or stream, serialization, buffer type negotiation, and processing.

In-place opcode applying a per-column additive delta to pixels within a specified area. Deltas are provided as a table of 32-bit floats stored in a memory block, with a scale factor. Provides constructors, serialization, buffer type negotiation, modified bounds, and processing.

In-place opcode applying a per-row multiplicative scale to pixels within a specified area. Scale factors are provided as a table of 32-bit floats. Includes constructors, serialization, buffer type negotiation, modified bounds, and processing.

In-place opcode applying a per-column multiplicative scale to pixels within a specified area. Scale factors are provided as a table of 32-bit floats. Provides constructors, serialization, buffer type negotiation, modified bounds, and processing.

A container class representing a list of DNG processing opcodes for a specific image processing stage (1–3). It owns pointers to dng_opcode objects, allows appending, clearing, swapping, applying to an image via a host/negative, serialization (spooling), fingerprinting, and parsing from a stream. Copy operations are intentionally disabled. Memory ownership and lifetime semantics of contained dng_opcode pointers are managed via AutoPtr during Append; details of destruction are in the implementation, not shown here.
Enumeration of all opcode IDs supported by this SDK version. Values identify specific image-processing operations encoded in DNG opcode lists.

Abstract base class for all DNG opcodes. Encapsulates opcode identity, versioning, flags, stage, and lifecycle for validating, serializing, and applying an operation to an image/negative. Derived classes implement Apply().
Concrete opcode used to carry and pass through opcode data with unrecognized ID values (e.g., from newer DNG versions). Stores raw data block and can serialize it; Apply likely acts as a no-op.

Abstract helper subclass of dng_opcode for filter-like operations that read from a source buffer and write to a destination buffer. Provides overridable hooks for bounds expansion, tiling, per-thread preparation, and processing tiles/areas.

Abstract helper subclass of dng_opcode for in-place pointwise operations that transform pixels within a single buffer. Provides hooks for preparation and per-area processing; derived classes implement ProcessArea.
Function type for zeroing a block of memory of byte length count starting at dPtr.

Concrete stream implementing file-based I/O; derives from dng_stream and provides read/write operations backed by a disk file. Manages an internal FILE* handle (fFile). Copying is disabled. Construction opens a file given a path, mode inferred from the output flag. The bufferSize hints the internal buffering used by the base stream. Destruction closes the file. Exact error behavior and mode mapping are defined in the implementation, not in this header.
direct_api_constructors: dng_file_stream(const char *filename, bool output, uint32 bufferSize)

objects.description: Abstract base class (specialization of dng_area_task) for filtering: reads from a source dng_image and writes to a destination dng_image over rectangular areas/tiles. Clients subclass it and implement ProcessArea; Start/Process coordinate multithreaded tiling and buffer setup. Holds per-thread AutoPtr<dng_memory_block> buffers and tracks source/destination planes, pixel types, and tiling parameters.

Built-in type. No custom types are defined in this header; the symbol gVerbose is an extern variable of type bool declared under qDNGValidate, but bool is a built-in type and thus not a custom type defined here.

Typedef likely provided by dng_types.h, but not defined in this header. Since the requirement is to include only types explicitly defined here, there are no custom definitions. The symbol gDumpLineLimit is an extern variable of type uint32 declared under qDNGValidate.

Abstract sink interface for receiving streamed bytes of decoded data from the lossless JPEG decoder. Clients subclass dng_spooler and implement Spool to consume count bytes from data. Has a protected virtual destructor to enforce deletion via derived classes; cannot be instantiated directly.

objects.definition: typedef struct dng_pthread_cond_impl *dng_pthread_cond_t;
objects.description: Opaque pointer to an internal condition variable implementation used by the DNG pthread shim. A special sentinel value DNG_PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER is provided for static initialization.

objects.definition: typedef unsigned long dng_pthread_key_t;
objects.description: Key for thread-specific storage in the DNG pthread shim, mapping to an unsigned long identifier.

objects.description: Opaque pointer to a read–write lock implementation used by the DNG pthread shim.

objects.definition: typedef void *pthread_rwlockattr_t;
