requirements: Both objects must be constructed. No additional preconditions.

functions.name: dng_date_time::Clear
functions.description: Sets the date/time to an invalid state.
requirements: Object must be constructed.

functions.name: dng_date_time::Parse
functions.description: Parses an EXIF-format date/time string into this object. Returns true on successful parse and if the resulting date/time is valid.
requirements: s must be a non-null C string.
Input should be an EXIF date/time string (e.g., per EXIF standard). Exact accepted formats beyond EXIF are unknown.
On failure, the object may be left invalid; caller should check the return value and/or IsValid().

functions.name: dng_time_zone::dng_time_zone
functions.description: Default constructor. Initializes to an invalid time zone (offset marked invalid).
requirements: Object must be constructed before use; initial IsValid() will return false until a valid offset is set.

functions.name: dng_time_zone::Clear
functions.description: Resets the time zone to an invalid state.
requirements: Object must be constructed.

functions.name: dng_time_zone::SetOffsetHours
functions.description: Sets the time zone offset from GMT as whole hours (converted internally to minutes).
requirements: For the resulting time zone to be valid, the effective offset must be within [-15, 15] hours (inclusive).
Large offsets may overflow only if SafeInt32Mult were not used; implementation uses SafeInt32Mult to compute minutes.
Caller should check IsValid() after setting.

functions.name: dng_time_zone::SetOffsetMinutes
functions.description: Sets the time zone offset from GMT directly in minutes (positive is ahead of GMT, negative is behind).
requirements: For validity, offset must be within [-900, 900] minutes. Caller should call IsValid() to verify.

functions.name: dng_time_zone::SetOffsetSeconds
functions.description: Sets the time zone offset from GMT in seconds, rounding to the nearest minute.
requirements: Input offset is in seconds. For the resulting zone to be valid, the rounded minutes must be within [-900, 900].
Rounding is to nearest minute (ties away from zero per implementation comments). Caller should verify with IsValid().

functions.name: dng_time_zone::IsValid
functions.description: Returns true if the stored offset is within the allowed range of [-900, 900] minutes.
requirements: None beyond a constructed object.

functions.name: dng_time_zone::NotValid
functions.description: Inverse of IsValid(). Returns true if the offset is outside the allowed range or not set.
requirements: None beyond a constructed object.

functions.name: dng_time_zone::OffsetMinutes
functions.description: Returns the stored GMT offset in minutes (positive ahead of GMT, negative behind).
requirements: If the zone is invalid, the returned value may be the internal invalid marker. Caller should check IsValid() before relying on the value.

functions.name: dng_time_zone::IsExactHourOffset
functions.description: Returns true if the time zone is valid and the offset is an exact number of hours (i.e., divisible by 60).
requirements: None beyond a constructed object.

functions.name: dng_time_zone::ExactHourOffset
functions.description: Returns the hour component of the offset (offsetMinutes / 60). Only meaningful if IsExactHourOffset() is true.
requirements: Caller should first ensure IsExactHourOffset() is true; otherwise the quotient may truncate fractional hours.

functions.name: dng_time_zone::Encode_ISO_8601
functions.description: Encodes the time zone offset as an ISO 8601 string (e.g., "+05:30" or "Z"). Exact formatting details depend on implementation.
requirements: Meaningful output requires a valid time zone (IsValid() == true). If invalid, formatting behavior is unknown.

functions.name: dng_date_time_info::dng_date_time_info
functions.description: Default constructor. Initializes a container for date/time/subseconds/time zone with an invalid/empty state and date-only flag false by default.
requirements: Object must be constructed before use.

functions.name: dng_date_time_info::IsValid
functions.description: Returns whether the contained date/time information is valid. Likely true if at least the date is valid, with optional time and zone. Exact criteria are not documented here.
requirements: None beyond a constructed object.
Callers should not assume time or zone are present even if IsValid() is true; check individual fields.

functions.name: dng_date_time_info::NotValid
functions.description: Inverse of IsValid().
requirements: None beyond a constructed object.

functions.name: dng_date_time_info::Clear
functions.description: Resets all fields to the default-constructed state (invalid/empty).
requirements: Object must be constructed.

functions.name: dng_date_time_info::DateTime
functions.description: Accessor returning a const reference to the stored date/time value.
requirements: The returned reference remains valid only as long as the dng_date_time_info object remains alive.
The returned date/time itself may be invalid; callers should check DateTime().IsValid().

functions.name: dng_date_time_info::SetDateTime
functions.description: Sets the stored date/time and marks the info as not date-only.
requirements: dt should represent a valid date/time for meaningful results; the method does not enforce validity.
After setting, callers may wish to set subseconds and time zone as needed.

functions.name: dng_date_time_info::Subseconds
functions.description: Accessor returning the stored subseconds string (as used by EXIF).
requirements: Reference remains valid only as long as the dng_date_time_info object remains alive.
May be empty if not set.

functions.name: dng_date_time_info::SetSubseconds
functions.description: Sets the subseconds string associated with the date/time (e.g., fractional seconds).
requirements: String s may be empty to clear subseconds. Exact format constraints are not documented.

functions.name: dng_date_time_info::TimeZone
functions.description: Accessor returning a const reference to the stored time zone.
requirements: Reference remains valid only as long as the dng_date_time_info object remains alive.
Returned time zone may be invalid; callers should check TimeZone().IsValid().

functions.name: dng_date_time_info::SetZone
functions.description: Sets the stored time zone.
requirements: zone should be valid for meaningful results; no enforcement is specified.
Caller may set to an invalid zone to indicate unknown zone.

functions.name: dng_date_time_info::Decode_ISO_8601
functions.description: Parses an ISO 8601 date/time string into this object, including optional time zone and subseconds if present.
requirements: s must be a non-null C string.
Exact accepted ISO 8601 variants are not specified here; caller should verify the result using IsValid() and check individual components.

functions.name: dng_date_time_info::Encode_ISO_8601
functions.description: Formats the stored date/time (and zone/subseconds if available) as an ISO 8601 string.
requirements: For meaningful output the stored date/time should be valid.
If the time zone is invalid/unknown, formatting behavior is implementation-defined.

functions.name: dng_date_time_info::Decode_IPTC_Date
functions.description: Parses an IPTC date string into the object (date portion).
requirements: s must be a non-null C string.
Exact accepted IPTC date format is not specified here; caller should verify success via IsValid() or by checking DateTime().IsValid().

functions.name: dng_date_time_info::Encode_IPTC_Date
functions.description: Formats the stored date as an IPTC date string.
requirements: Requires a valid date component for meaningful output.

functions.name: dng_date_time_info::Decode_IPTC_Time
functions.description: Parses an IPTC time string into the object (time portion, possibly including zone).
requirements: s must be a non-null C string.
Exact accepted IPTC time format is not specified here; caller should verify the resulting time via DateTime().IsValid() and/or TimeZone().IsValid().

functions.name: dng_date_time_info::Encode_IPTC_Time
functions.description: Formats the stored time (and possibly zone) as an IPTC time string.
requirements: Requires a valid time component for meaningful output.

functions.name: CurrentDateTimeAndZone
functions.description: Populates info with the current system date/time and time zone.
requirements: info must be a valid reference; its contents will be overwritten.
Caller should expect platform-dependent time zone determination (e.g., daylight saving rules).

functions.name: DecodeUnixTime
functions.description: Converts a 32-bit UNIX time value (seconds since Jan 1, 1970, UTC) to a dng_date_time in UTC.
requirements: dt must be a valid reference to receive the result.
unixTime is a 32-bit seconds-since-epoch value; behavior beyond 2038 depends on handling of overflow and is not documented.

functions.name: LocalTimeZone
functions.description: Computes the local time zone for the given date/time (e.g., accounting for daylight saving).
requirements: dt should represent the target local date/time; dt should be valid for meaningful results.
Behavior depends on system time zone rules for the provided date.

functions.name: dng_date_time_storage_info::dng_date_time_storage_info
functions.description: Default constructor. Initializes to an invalid state (no stored offset/format).
requirements: Object must be constructed before use; IsValid() will be false until properly initialized.

functions.name: dng_date_time_storage_info::dng_date_time_storage_info
functions.description: Constructs storage metadata identifying where and how a date/time was stored (file offset and encoding format).
requirements: offset is a byte offset within some file; must be valid for subsequent use.
format must be one of dng_date_time_format_* values.
IsValid() indicates whether the combination is considered valid.

functions.name: dng_date_time_storage_info::IsValid
functions.description: Returns true if an offset/format pair is currently valid.
requirements: None beyond a constructed object.

functions.name: dng_date_time_storage_info::Offset
functions.description: Returns the stored file offset. Throws a dng_exception with fErrorCode == dng_error_unknown if the object is not in a valid state.
requirements: Caller must ensure IsValid() returns true before calling, or be prepared to handle a thrown dng_exception.

functions.name: dng_date_time_storage_info::Format
functions.description: Returns the stored date/time format. Throws a dng_exception with fErrorCode == dng_error_unknown if the object is not valid.
requirements: Caller must ensure IsValid() returns true before calling, or be prepared to handle a thrown dng_exception.

functions.name: dng_fingerprint::dng_fingerprint
functions.description: Default-constructs a fingerprint. Based on usage in Clear(), this constructor initializes the 16-byte fingerprint to all zeros (an "invalid"/null fingerprint). Use to create an empty/placeholder fingerprint.
requirements: No arguments or special preconditions.
Resulting instance is considered null/invalid until populated.

functions.name: dng_fingerprint::IsNull
functions.description: Returns true if the fingerprint is all zeros. Useful to detect an uninitialized/invalid fingerprint value.
requirements: The object must be a valid dng_fingerprint instance.

functions.name: dng_fingerprint::IsValid
functions.description: Returns true if the fingerprint is not all zeros. Expresses the intention of testing validity (inverse of IsNull).
requirements: The object must be a valid dng_fingerprint instance.

functions.name: dng_fingerprint::Clear
functions.description: Resets the fingerprint to an all-zeros value, indicating an invalid fingerprint. Implemented via assignment to a default-constructed fingerprint.
requirements: The object must be a valid dng_fingerprint instance. After calling, the fingerprint becomes null/invalid.

functions.name: dng_fingerprint::operator==
functions.description: Compares two fingerprints for byte-wise equality.
requirements: Both operands must be valid dng_fingerprint objects.

functions.name: dng_fingerprint::operator!=
functions.description: Returns the logical negation of operator==, i.e., true if the fingerprints differ.
requirements: Both operands must be valid dng_fingerprint objects.

functions.name: dng_fingerprint::Collapse32
functions.description: Produces a 32-bit hash value derived from the 16-byte fingerprint, intended for faster hashing or bucketing of fingerprints. Exact algorithm not documented here.
requirements: The fingerprint should be initialized (non-garbage).
Returned value is a lossy reduction and not a cryptographic hash.

functions.name: dng_fingerprint::ToUtf8HexString
functions.description: Writes the fingerprint as a null-terminated UTF-8 hexadecimal string into the provided buffer. For a 16-byte fingerprint, this is 32 hex characters plus a null terminator.
requirements: resultStr must point to a writable buffer of at least 2 * kDNGFingerprintSize + 1 bytes (33 bytes for MD5).
The fingerprint should be initialized; null fingerprints will serialize as 32 zeros.

functions.name: dng_fingerprint::FromUtf8HexString
functions.description: Parses a UTF-8 hexadecimal string into the fingerprint’s bytes. Returns true on success, false on failure.
requirements: inputStr must be a readable, null-terminated string containing exactly 2 * kDNGFingerprintSize hexadecimal characters (32 for MD5) followed by '\0'.
Only valid hexadecimal digits are accepted; failure returns false.
On failure, the resulting state of the fingerprint is not specified in this header.

functions.name: dng_fingerprint_less_than::operator()
functions.description: Strict-weak-order comparator for fingerprints using lexicographic byte order (memcmp over the 16-byte arrays). Suitable for sorting and ordered containers.
requirements: Inputs must be valid dng_fingerprint objects.
Comparison is raw byte-wise; no locale or numeric interpretation involved.

functions.name: dng_md5_printer::dng_md5_printer
functions.description: Constructs an MD5 printer (incremental hasher) with internal state initialized for hashing operations.
requirements: No arguments. After construction, call Process() one or more times, then Result() to obtain the fingerprint.

functions.name: dng_md5_printer::~dng_md5_printer
functions.description: Virtual destructor for the MD5 printer. Performs no documented work in this header (empty inline body).
requirements: No special requirements.

functions.name: dng_md5_printer::Reset
functions.description: Resets the MD5 printer’s internal state, discarding any previously processed data and restarting the hash computation.
requirements: Call between hashing sessions if you need to reuse the instance for a new digest.
After Reset(), previously obtained Result() remains valid as a value but is no longer related to new processed data.

functions.name: dng_md5_printer::Process
functions.description: Feeds raw bytes into the MD5 hasher. Can be called repeatedly to hash data in chunks.
requirements: data must point to at least inputLen bytes of readable memory.
inputLen is the number of bytes to hash and may be zero.
Do not modify the buffer while hashing is in progress on the same memory region (usual thread-safety considerations).
Must be called before Result() if you want non-empty input included.

functions.name: dng_md5_printer::Result
functions.description: Finalizes (if needed) and returns the MD5 fingerprint of all bytes processed so far as a const reference to an internal dng_fingerprint.
requirements: May be called after zero or more calls to Process().
The returned reference remains valid as long as the dng_md5_printer object remains alive and unchanged; modifying or Reset()'ing the printer may change subsequent results.
Thread-safety is not guaranteed by this header.

functions.name: dng_md5_printer_stream::dng_md5_printer_stream
functions.description: Constructs an empty write-only stream that computes an MD5 fingerprint over all bytes written sequentially to it.
requirements: No arguments. After construction, write data via DoWrite() at offset 0 and increasing sequentially. Call Result() to get the fingerprint.

functions.name: dng_md5_printer_stream::DoGetLength
functions.description: Returns the current logical length (number of bytes written) of the MD5 printer stream.
requirements: None beyond a valid object state.

functions.name: dng_md5_printer_stream::DoRead
functions.signature: virtual void dng_md5_printer_stream::DoRead(void * data, uint32 count, uint64 offset)
functions.description: Read operation is unsupported and will trigger a program error (throws via ThrowProgramError). This stream is write-only for hashing.
requirements: Callers must not invoke DoRead(); it is intentionally unsupported and will error.
If invoked, expect an exception or program error per ThrowProgramError().

functions.name: dng_md5_printer_stream::DoSetLength
functions.description: Sets the logical length of the stream. Only setting the length to the current end offset is allowed; any other value triggers a program error.
requirements: length must equal the current length returned by DoGetLength(); otherwise, a program error is thrown.
Used primarily to enforce no truncation/extension semantics.

functions.name: dng_md5_printer_stream::DoWrite
functions.signature: virtual void dng_md5_printer_stream::DoWrite(const void *data, uint32 count2, uint64 offset)
functions.description: Writes data to the stream and feeds it into the MD5 hasher. Only strictly sequential writes at the current end offset are allowed.
requirements: offset must equal the current end offset (no seeking or out-of-order writes); otherwise a program error is thrown.
data must point to at least count2 bytes of readable memory.
count2 may be zero to perform a no-op write.
Each successful write advances the end offset by count2.

functions.name: dng_md5_printer_stream::Result
functions.description: Flushes the stream and returns the MD5 fingerprint of all bytes written so far. Delegates to dng_md5_printer::Result().
requirements: All intended data must have been written before calling Result() to get the final hash.
Calling Result() may finalize internal hashing state; subsequent writes should be avoided unless re-hashing behavior is documented elsewhere (not specified here).

functions.name: dng_stream::dng_stream
functions.signature: dng_stream::dng_stream(dng_abort_sniffer *sniffer = NULL, uint32 bufferSize = kDefaultBufferSize, uint64 offsetInOriginalFile = kDNGStreamInvalidOffset)
functions.description: Protected constructor for initializing a stream abstraction with an optional abort sniffer, buffer size, and an offset that records where this stream’s data began in an original file. Intended for subclasses that provide actual I/O via the Do* virtuals.
requirements: sniffer may be NULL to indicate no sniffer.
bufferSize is a size in bytes for the internal buffer; must be a reasonable nonzero value (exact range not specified).
offsetInOriginalFile may be kDNGStreamInvalidOffset to indicate unknown origin offset.

functions.name: dng_stream::~dng_stream
functions.description: Virtual destructor for the stream abstraction. Cleans up internal buffers and resources.
requirements: Object must be destroyed only once and while no further operations are attempted on it afterwards.

functions.name: dng_stream::SwapBytes
functions.description: Returns whether the stream will swap byte order on input/output operations for multi-byte values.

functions.name: dng_stream::SetSwapBytes
functions.description: Enable or disable byte-swapping for subsequent multi-byte reads/writes.
requirements: Affects future I/O operations only; existing stored values are not retroactively changed.

functions.name: dng_stream::BigEndian
functions.description: Returns true if the stream is configured to treat data as big-endian (equivalently, if byte swapping is set such that big-endian values are produced/consumed on the current platform).

functions.name: dng_stream::SetBigEndian
functions.description: Sets the stream to treat data as big-endian (or not). Controls whether multi-byte reads/writes are byte-swapped.
requirements: Affects future I/O operations only.

functions.name: dng_stream::LittleEndian
functions.description: Returns true if the stream is configured for little-endian data (the inverse of BigEndian).

functions.name: dng_stream::SetLittleEndian
functions.description: Sets the stream to treat data as little-endian (or not) by delegating to SetBigEndian(!littleEndian).
requirements: Affects future I/O operations only.

functions.name: dng_stream::BufferSize
functions.description: Returns the size in bytes of the internal I/O buffer used by the stream.

functions.name: dng_stream::Length
functions.description: Returns the total length of readable data in the stream. May query the underlying source on first call and cache the result.
requirements: May throw via underlying DoGetLength if length cannot be determined (not explicitly documented).

functions.name: dng_stream::Position
functions.description: Returns the current byte offset from the start of the stream for the next read or write, depending on operation context.

functions.name: dng_stream::PositionInOriginalFile
functions.description: Returns the position in the original file corresponding to the current stream position, if an origin offset is known; otherwise returns kDNGStreamInvalidOffset.

functions.name: dng_stream::OffsetInOriginalFile
functions.description: Returns the saved origin offset in the original file if known, otherwise kDNGStreamInvalidOffset.

functions.name: dng_stream::Data
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the entire stream contents if available as a single contiguous memory block; otherwise returns NULL.
requirements: Caller must not write through the returned pointer.
Pointer is valid as long as the stream remains unchanged (exact lifetime not specified).

functions.name: dng_stream::AsMemoryBlock
functions.description: Returns the entire stream contents as a single allocated memory block, copying data if necessary, using the provided allocator.
requirements: allocator must be a valid dng_memory_allocator instance capable of allocating at least Length() bytes.
Caller assumes ownership/obligation to free per allocator’s rules (freeing protocol not specified here).

functions.name: dng_stream::SetReadPosition
functions.description: Seeks the stream’s read position to the specified byte offset from the start.
requirements: offset is a byte position from the stream start; behavior for offsets past end is not documented.

functions.name: dng_stream::Skip
functions.description: Advances the read position forward by delta bytes (equivalent to SetReadPosition(Position()+delta)).
requirements: delta is a non-negative byte count; behavior on overflow or past-end is not documented.

functions.name: dng_stream::Get
functions.description: Reads count bytes from the stream into data and advances the read position. Throws a dng_exception with fErrorCode == dng_error_end_of_file if insufficient data are available.
requirements: data must point to a writable buffer of at least count bytes.
count is the exact number of bytes to read.
Caller must handle dng_exception with fErrorCode dng_error_end_of_file on EOF.

functions.name: dng_stream::SetWritePosition
functions.description: Seeks the stream’s write position to the specified byte offset from the start for subsequent Put operations.
requirements: offset is a byte position; behavior for seeking beyond current length is not specified.

functions.name: dng_stream::Flush
functions.description: Flushes any buffered writes to the underlying storage, ensuring data are written out.
requirements: Should be called to force pending writes to be committed; exact flushing semantics depend on the concrete stream.

functions.name: dng_stream::SetLength
functions.description: Sets the total length of available data in the stream to length bytes.
requirements: length is the new size in bytes; truncation/extension behavior beyond setting the length is not described.

functions.name: dng_stream::Put
functions.description: Writes count bytes from data to the stream at the current write position and advances the position.
requirements: data must point to at least count bytes of readable memory.
count is the exact number of bytes to write.

functions.name: dng_stream::Get_uint8
functions.description: Reads a single unsigned 8-bit value from the stream and advances the read position. May use internal buffer for efficiency. Throws on EOF.
requirements: Caller must handle dng_exception with fErrorCode dng_error_end_of_file if not enough data.

functions.name: dng_stream::Put_uint8
functions.description: Writes a single unsigned 8-bit value to the stream at the current write position and advances the position.

functions.name: dng_stream::Get_uint16
functions.description: Reads an unsigned 16-bit integer and advances the read position. Applies byte swapping if enabled.
requirements: Caller must handle dng_exception with fErrorCode dng_error_end_of_file if insufficient data.

functions.name: dng_stream::Put_uint16
functions.description: Writes an unsigned 16-bit integer and advances the write position. Applies byte swapping if enabled.

functions.name: dng_stream::Get_uint32
functions.description: Reads an unsigned 32-bit integer and advances the read position. Applies byte swapping if enabled.
requirements: Caller must handle dng_exception with fErrorCode dng_error_end_of_file if insufficient data.

functions.name: dng_stream::Put_uint32
functions.description: Writes an unsigned 32-bit integer and advances the write position. Applies byte swapping if enabled.

functions.name: dng_stream::Get_uint64
functions.description: Reads an unsigned 64-bit integer and advances the read position. Applies byte swapping if enabled.
requirements: Caller must handle dng_exception with fErrorCode dng_error_end_of_file if insufficient data.

functions.name: dng_stream::Put_uint64
functions.description: Writes an unsigned 64-bit integer and advances the write position. Applies byte swapping if enabled.

functions.name: dng_stream::Get_int8
functions.description: Reads a signed 8-bit integer (via Get_uint8 cast) and advances the read position. Throws on EOF.
requirements: Caller must handle dng_exception with fErrorCode dng_error_end_of_file if insufficient data.

functions.name: dng_stream::Put_int8
functions.description: Writes a signed 8-bit integer (via Put_uint8 cast) and advances the write position.

functions.name: dng_stream::Get_int16
functions.description: Reads a signed 16-bit integer (via Get_uint16 cast) and advances the read position. Applies byte swapping if enabled.
requirements: Caller must handle dng_exception with fErrorCode dng_error_end_of_file if insufficient data.

functions.name: dng_stream::Put_int16
functions.description: Writes a signed 16-bit integer (via Put_uint16 cast) and advances the write position. Applies byte swapping if enabled.

functions.name: dng_stream::Get_int32
functions.description: Reads a signed 32-bit integer (via Get_uint32 cast) and advances the read position. Applies byte swapping if enabled.
requirements: Caller must handle dng_exception with fErrorCode dng_error_end_of_file if insufficient data.

functions.name: dng_stream::Put_int32
functions.description: Writes a signed 32-bit integer (via Put_uint32 cast) and advances the write position. Applies byte swapping if enabled.

functions.name: dng_stream::Get_int64
functions.description: Reads a signed 64-bit integer (via Get_uint64 cast) and advances the read position. Applies byte swapping if enabled.
requirements: Caller must handle dng_exception with fErrorCode dng_error_end_of_file if insufficient data.

functions.name: dng_stream::Put_int64
functions.description: Writes a signed 64-bit integer (via Put_uint64 cast) and advances the write position. Applies byte swapping if enabled.

functions.name: dng_stream::Get_real32
functions.description: Reads a 32-bit IEEE float and advances the read position. Applies byte swapping if enabled. Throws on EOF.
requirements: Caller must handle dng_exception with fErrorCode dng_error_end_of_file if insufficient data.

functions.name: dng_stream::Put_real32
functions.description: Writes a 32-bit IEEE float and advances the write position. Applies byte swapping if enabled.

functions.name: dng_stream::Get_real64
functions.description: Reads a 64-bit IEEE float and advances the read position. Applies byte swapping if enabled. Throws on EOF.
requirements: Caller must handle dng_exception with fErrorCode dng_error_end_of_file if insufficient data.

functions.name: dng_stream::Put_real64
functions.description: Writes a 64-bit IEEE float and advances the write position. Applies byte swapping if enabled.

functions.name: dng_stream::Get_CString
functions.description: Reads an 8-bit character C-string from the stream, always consuming up to and including the terminating NUL (0) in the stream (or until EOF), but copies at most maxLength bytes into data. Throws dng_error_end_of_file if the stream ends before a NUL is seen.
requirements: data must point to a writable buffer of at least maxLength bytes.
Caller must handle dng_exception with fErrorCode dng_error_end_of_file if NUL not found before EOF.

functions.name: dng_stream::Get_UString
functions.description: Reads a 16-bit character string from the stream until a 16-bit NUL is encountered (or EOF). Characters are truncated to 8 bits when stored in data. At most maxLength bytes are written to data. Throws dng_error_end_of_file if EOF occurs before a NUL.
requirements: data must point to a writable buffer of at least maxLength bytes.
Caller must handle dng_exception with fErrorCode dng_error_end_of_file if NUL not found before EOF.

functions.name: dng_stream::PutZeros
functions.description: Writes count zero bytes to the stream at the current write position.

functions.name: dng_stream::PadAlign2
functions.description: Writes zero bytes as needed to advance the write position to the next multiple of 2.

functions.name: dng_stream::PadAlign4
functions.description: Writes zero bytes as needed to advance the write position to the next multiple of 4.

functions.name: dng_stream::TagValue_uint32
functions.description: Reads a value whose size is determined by tagType from the stream and returns it as an unsigned 32-bit integer. Applies byte swapping if enabled and the tag size exceeds one byte. Advances the read position. Throws on EOF.
requirements: tagType must be a valid tag type indicating the size/format of the value (exact mapping not specified here).
Caller must handle dng_exception with fErrorCode dng_error_end_of_file if insufficient data.

functions.name: dng_stream::TagValue_int32
functions.description: Reads a value whose size is determined by tagType from the stream and returns it as a signed 32-bit integer. Applies byte swapping if enabled for multi-byte values. Advances the read position. Throws on EOF.
requirements: tagType must be a valid tag type indicating the size/format of the value (exact mapping not specified here).
Caller must handle dng_exception with fErrorCode dng_error_end_of_file if insufficient data.

functions.name: dng_stream::TagValue_urational
functions.description: Reads a value whose size is determined by tagType and returns it as a dng_urational. Applies byte swapping if enabled for multi-byte values. Advances the read position. Throws on EOF.

functions.name: TempBigEndian::TempBigEndian

functions.name: dng_memory_data
functions.description: Default constructor. Creates an empty memory buffer using malloc-based semantics. On construction, no bytes are allocated and Buffer() may be null until Allocate is called. Throws dng_memory_full (dng_error_memory) if an internal allocation failure occurs.
requirements: If no allocation has been performed, the returned Buffer() may be null; callers must check before dereferencing.
Any use of the buffer must not exceed the number of bytes allocated (which is zero until Allocate is called).

functions.name: ~dng_memory_data
functions.description: Destructor. Releases any allocated memory using free. Object cleanup only; does not throw.
requirements: After destruction, any previously obtained Buffer() pointers become invalid and must not be used.

functions.name: dng_memory_data::Allocate
functions.description: Clears any existing allocation and allocates a new buffer of ‘size’ bytes using malloc. Throws dng_memory_full (dng_error_memory) on failure.
requirements: size is the number of bytes to allocate; must be representable.
Existing buffer (if any) is released; any previously obtained Buffer() pointers become invalid after this call.
On allocation failure, this function throws; callers must handle exceptions.
Do not read or write beyond ‘size’ bytes via the returned pointer.

functions.name: dng_memory_data::Clear
functions.description: Releases any allocated memory using free. Leaves the object in a valid, empty state so Allocate can be called again.
requirements: Any previously obtained Buffer() pointers become invalid after this call.
After Clear, Buffer() may return null and there are zero valid bytes.

functions.name: dng_memory_data::Buffer
functions.description: Returns a non-const pointer to the underlying buffer. Valid for as many bytes as were allocated. May be null if no allocation has occurred.
requirements: Caller must not read or write beyond the allocated size.
If no memory is allocated, the returned pointer may be null; callers must check before use.

functions.name: dng_memory_data::Buffer_char
functions.description: Returns the buffer pointer cast to char*. Valid for as many bytes as were allocated.
requirements: Do not access beyond the allocated byte size.

functions.name: dng_memory_data::Buffer_uint8
functions.description: Returns the buffer pointer cast to uint8*. Valid for as many bytes as were allocated.
requirements: Array-style indexing must not exceed the allocated byte size.

functions.name: dng_memory_data::Buffer_uint16

requirements: Element access must not exceed floor(allocated_bytes / sizeof(uint16)) elements.

Alignment is not guaranteed beyond malloc’s guarantees; caller should ensure alignment if required by platform.

functions.name: ~dng_memory_block

functions.name: dng_memory_block::Clone
functions.description: Creates and returns a new dng_memory_block that is a copy of this block using the provided allocator. Intended for duplicating image buffers and other large allocations.
requirements: allocator must be a valid dng_memory_allocator reference capable of allocating at least LogicalSize() bytes.
May throw dng_exception with error code dng_error_memory on allocation failure; callers must handle exceptions.
Returned pointer must be freed/destroyed according to allocator’s ownership model.

functions.name: dng_memory_block::LogicalSize
functions.description: Returns the logical (usable) size in bytes of this memory block.
requirements: None beyond using the returned size as the maximum number of bytes that may be safely read/written via Buffer().

functions.name: dng_memory_block::Buffer
functions.description: Returns a non-const pointer to the block's buffer. Pointer is 16-byte aligned (the class aligns the stored pointer). Valid for LogicalSize() bytes.
requirements: Do not access beyond LogicalSize() bytes.

functions.name: ~dng_memory_allocator
functions.description: Virtual destructor for the allocator interface. Allows proper cleanup via base pointer.
requirements: Derived allocators must ensure any outstanding allocations are properly managed before destruction (based on their ownership model).

functions.name: dng_memory_allocator::Allocate
functions.description: Allocates a dng_memory_block with at least ‘size’ bytes of valid storage. Throws dng_exception with fErrorCode == dng_error_memory on failure.
requirements: size is the requested logical size in bytes.
Callers must handle exceptions on allocation failure.
Returned block’s Buffer() is 16-byte aligned (per dng_memory_block behavior); do not access beyond LogicalSize() bytes.
Caller is responsible for freeing/destroying the returned block according to the allocator’s contract.

functions.name: operator==
functions.signature: template <class T> bool operator== (const dng_std_allocator<T> &a1, const dng_std_allocator<T> &a2)
functions.description: Equality comparison for dng_std_allocator. Always returns true; all instances are interchangeable. Suitable for use with standard containers’ allocator equality requirements.
requirements: Template parameter T must denote the value_type the allocator allocates.
No runtime requirements; result is always true.

functions.name: operator!=
functions.signature: template <class T> bool operator!= (const dng_std_allocator<T> &a1, const dng_std_allocator<T> &a2)
functions.description: Inequality comparison for dng_std_allocator. Always returns false; all instances compare equal.
requirements: Template parameter T must denote the value_type the allocator allocates.
No runtime requirements; result is always false.

functions.name: dng_memory_stream::dng_memory_stream
functions.description: Constructs a memory-backed dng_stream that stores data in pages allocated via the provided allocator. Optionally uses a sniffer to allow user cancellation during operations. Page size controls the allocation granularity for the internal storage. Typical usage: create the stream with a live allocator, then write to or read from it like any dng_stream; data are kept in memory and can be accessed or copied out later.
requirements: allocator must be a valid dng_memory_allocator object that remains alive for at least the lifetime of the dng_memory_stream (allocator is stored by reference).
sniffer may be NULL; if non-NULL it must remain valid while the stream may call it for cancellation checks.
pageSize controls the unit of allocation for the stream; should be a positive, non-zero value (inferred from "Unit of allocation").
Construction must occur before any use of the stream; no other special initialization is required beyond passing valid arguments.

functions.name: dng_memory_stream::~dng_memory_stream
functions.description: Destructor for the memory-backed stream. Releases any memory/pages owned by the stream and finalizes the object. Normal C++ RAII usage: when the object goes out of scope or is deleted, its resources are freed.
requirements: Do not use the dng_memory_stream instance after destruction.
Ensure no operations are in progress on this stream when it is destroyed (general C++ object lifetime rule).

functions.name: dng_memory_stream::CopyToStream
functions.description: Copies count bytes from this memory stream to the specified destination stream. Intended for exporting a portion of the in-memory data to another dng_stream implementation (e.g., file or another memory stream). The exact source offset is based on the stream's current position semantics from dng_stream (details not shown here).
requirements: dstStream must be a valid dng_stream object capable of accepting count bytes (i.e., writable).

count is the number of bytes to copy and should be less than or equal to the available readable bytes from the source according to dng_stream positioning; exceeding available data will likely result in an error/exception (inferred from typical stream behavior).
The source stream (this) must be in a readable state; destination must be in a writable state (inferred from function purpose).

If a dng_abort_sniffer was provided at construction, copy operations may consult it for cancellation; callers should be prepared for an early termination/exception if cancellation is signaled (inferred from presence of sniffer).

functions.name: dng_host::dng_host
functions.description: Constructs a dng_host, optionally providing a custom memory allocator and an abort sniffer. Used as the main control/communication object between the application and the DNG SDK. Defaults to global singletons if NULLs are passed. Intended to be thread-safe when using distinct dng_host instances.
requirements: allocator may be NULL; if non-NULL, it must remain valid for the lifetime of this dng_host (the host does not delete it).
sniffer may be NULL; if non-NULL, it must remain valid for the lifetime of this dng_host (the host does not delete it).
Multiple dng_host instances may be created; each instance is thread-safe for independent use. The application must provide external synchronization if sharing a single dng_host across threads.

functions.name: dng_host::~dng_host
functions.description: Destructor for dng_host. Cleans up host-internal resources. The memory allocator and abort sniffer associated with the host are not deleted. Objects returned from the host (e.g., dng_image) can still be used after the host is deleted.
requirements: Do not expect the host to delete the allocator or sniffer; manage their lifetimes externally.
Ensure any derived-class overrides follow base-class semantics (no deletion of allocator/sniffer).

functions.name: dng_host::Allocator
functions.description: Returns a reference to the host’s memory allocator for allocating SDK memory blocks.
requirements: The returned reference remains valid as long as the underlying allocator object remains alive (host does not own/delete the allocator).
Caller must not delete the allocator via this reference unless it owns it externally.

functions.name: dng_host::Allocate
functions.description: Allocates a new dng_memory_block of the requested logical size using the host’s allocator. On failure it will signal memory exhaustion (e.g., by calling ThrowMemoryFull).
requirements: logicalSize specifies the number of usable bytes requested; must fit within allocator limits.
Caller must be prepared for allocation failure via the SDK’s error mechanism (e.g., an exception/ThrowMemoryFull).
The returned block must be released using the appropriate dng_memory_block mechanism (ownership/cleanup as defined by dng_memory_block; exact details not specified here).

functions.name: dng_host::SetSniffer
functions.description: Sets the abort sniffer used by the host to check for user cancellation and to report progress.
requirements: sniffer may be NULL to indicate no abort/progress handling.
If non-NULL, sniffer must remain valid for the lifetime of its use by this dng_host (the host will not delete it).

functions.name: dng_host::Sniffer
functions.description: Returns the currently configured abort sniffer pointer (may be NULL).
requirements: Caller must handle a possible NULL return before dereferencing.

functions.name: dng_host::SniffForAbort
functions.description: Checks the configured abort sniffer for a pending abort. Should signal user cancellation (e.g., by calling ThrowUserCanceled) if an abort is pending.
requirements: May signal cancellation; callers must be prepared to handle the SDK’s cancellation mechanism (e.g., an exception).
Safe to call periodically during long-running operations.

functions.name: dng_host::SetNeedsMeta
functions.description: Sets whether full XMP metadata parsing is required during processing.
requirements: No special constraints; pass true when metadata is required, false for faster, metadata-free checks.

functions.name: dng_host::NeedsMeta
functions.description: Returns whether full XMP metadata parsing is requested.

functions.name: dng_host::SetNeedsImage
functions.description: Sets whether actual image data is needed (as opposed to just metadata or readability checks).
requirements: No special constraints; pass true if image data will be consumed downstream.

functions.name: dng_host::NeedsImage
functions.description: Returns whether image data is required for the current operation.

functions.name: dng_host::SetForPreview
functions.description: Indicates that rendered data should be optimized for preview-quality use (potentially faster, lower quality) rather than full-quality output.
requirements: No special constraints; set true to request preview-quality processing.

functions.name: dng_host::ForPreview
functions.description: Returns whether preview-quality rendering is requested. Data produced when true should not be written back to a DNG file except as a preview image.

functions.name: dng_host::SetMinimumSize
functions.description: Sets the minimum desired image size (long side, in pixels). If non-zero, images smaller than this may be read at full size; if zero, full-size is allowed.
requirements: size is in pixels of the image’s long dimension; zero means no minimum (full-size permitted).

functions.name: dng_host::MinimumSize
functions.description: Gets the minimum desired image size (long side, in pixels). Zero means no minimum constraint.

functions.name: dng_host::SetPreferredSize
functions.description: Sets the preferred preview image size (long side, in pixels). Zero requests a full-resolution image.
requirements: size is in pixels of the image’s long dimension; zero requests full resolution.

functions.name: dng_host::PreferredSize
functions.description: Gets the preferred preview size (long side, in pixels). Zero indicates a full-resolution request.

functions.name: dng_host::SetMaximumSize
functions.description: Sets the maximum preview image size (long side, in pixels). Zero indicates no maximum limit.
requirements: size is in pixels of the image’s long dimension; zero means no maximum.

functions.name: dng_host::MaximumSize
functions.description: Gets the maximum preview size (long side, in pixels). Zero means no maximum limit.

functions.name: dng_host::SetCropFactor
functions.description: Sets the crop factor, defined as the fraction of the image that remains after cropping. Used to adjust size targets to account for cropping.
requirements: cropFactor is a fraction; exact valid range is not specified here (typical range would be (0,1], but the header does not state constraints).

functions.name: dng_host::CropFactor
functions.description: Gets the crop factor (fraction of image kept after crop).

functions.name: dng_host::ValidateSizes
functions.description: Normalizes/adjusts the minimum, preferred, and maximum size settings to ensure they are reasonable and mutually consistent.
requirements: Call after setting Minimum/Preferred/Maximum sizes to let the host enforce consistency.
No specific input range guarantees are documented; unreasonable inputs may be adjusted internally.

functions.name: dng_host::SetSaveDNGVersion
functions.description: Specifies the DNG file format version to which saved files should be compatible.
requirements: version must be a valid DNG version code expected by the SDK (exact accepted values not documented here).

functions.name: dng_host::SaveDNGVersion
functions.description: Returns the DNG version that the host intends to preserve compatibility with when saving.

functions.name: dng_host::SetSaveLinearDNG
functions.description: Forces saving as a linear DNG if set to true.
requirements: No special constraints; set according to desired output format.

functions.name: dng_host::SaveLinearDNG
functions.description: Determines whether the output should be a linear DNG for the given negative. Default behavior is governed by internal policy and the SetSaveLinearDNG flag.
requirements: negative must be a valid, initialized dng_negative describing the image to be saved.

functions.name: dng_host::SetKeepOriginalFile
functions.description: Controls whether the original RAW file data block should be retained when saving.
requirements: No special constraints; set according to desired archival behavior.

functions.name: dng_host::KeepOriginalFile
functions.description: Returns whether the original RAW file data block should be retained.

functions.name: dng_host::IsTransientError
functions.description: Tests whether an error code represents a transient, planned-for condition (e.g., user cancellation or memory exhaustion). Can be used to decide whether to continue processing in the presence of non-transient errors.
requirements: code must be a valid dng_error_code.

functions.name: dng_host::PerformAreaTask
functions.description: Top-level bottleneck for image processing tasks over a rectangular area. Default implementation calls dng_area_task::PerformAreaTask on the task. Can be overridden to provide multiprocessing.
requirements: task must be a valid, initialized dng_area_task suitable for processing the specified area.
area must be within the valid bounds expected by the task implementation.
Callers should not assume parallel execution in the default implementation.

functions.name: dng_host::PerformAreaTaskThreads
functions.description: Returns the number of threads used by PerformAreaTask. Default implementation returns 1 (single-threaded).

functions.name: dng_host::Make_dng_exif

functions.signature: virtual dng_image * dng_host::Make_dng_image(const dng_rect &bounds, uint32 planes, uint32 pixelType)
functions.description: Factory method to create a dng_image (often a dng_simple_image) with given bounds, number of planes, and pixel type. Override to customize allocation or to return a derived type.
requirements: bounds specifies the image rectangle to allocate.
planes must match the intended image’s number of planes (e.g., channels).

functions.description: Factory method to parse and construct a dng_opcode-derived instance for the given opcode ID from the provided stream. Override to change or extend opcode handling.
requirements: opcodeID must identify a supported opcode; unsupported IDs may result in differing behavior depending on implementation (unspecified here).
stream must be positioned and readable as expected for the opcode’s data format.
May return a heap-allocated object owned by the caller; exact ownership/lifetime rules are not specified here.

functions.name: dng_host::ApplyOpcodeList
functions.description: Applies a list of opcodes to an image in the context of a given negative. Implementations may mutate or replace the image via the AutoPtr reference.
requirements: list must contain valid opcodes for the target image/negative.
negative must be a valid, initialized dng_negative.
image must reference a valid dng_image (AutoPtr must not be null).
Caller should expect the image to be modified or replaced by the operation.

functions.name: dng_host::ResampleImage
functions.description: Resamples srcImage into dstImage. Override to control the resampling method used by the SDK.
requirements: srcImage must be a valid initialized image.
dstImage must be allocated and compatible with the desired resampled dimensions/format as expected by the implementation (exact expectations not specified here).

functions.name: dng_set_minimum_priority::dng_set_minimum_priority
functions.description: RAII helper that temporarily sets the current thread’s priority to the minimum and stores the previous priority, restoring it in the destructor.
