functions.name: dng_image::PixelRange
functions.description: Returns the maximum magnitude of the pixel value range for the current pixel type. For unsigned types, valid sample values are [0, return]; for signed types, range is (return - 0x8000U) to +0x7FFF (per comment); for ttFloat the semantic range is [0.0, 1.0] and this returns 1.

functions.name: dng_image::RepeatingTile
functions.description: Returns a rectangle indicating the preferred tile stride/size for accessing this image. Useful for iterating in optimal chunks.
requirements: None documented; returned rectangle semantics depend on concrete implementation.

functions.name: dng_image::Get
functions.signature: void dng_image::Get(dng_pixel_buffer &buffer, edge_option edgeOption = edge_none, uint32 repeatV = 1, uint32 repeatH = 1) const
functions.description: Reads pixels from the image into the provided pixel buffer, padding edges according to edgeOption. repeatV/repeatH specify the amount of repeated padding for edge_repeat and edge_repeat_zero_last.
requirements: buffer must be initialized/allocated for the target area (format and plane layout compatible with this image; not explicitly documented).
If edgeOption is edge_repeat or edge_repeat_zero_last, repeatV and repeatH should be positive (>= 1) and reflect the amount of repeated padding needed (explicitly referenced in comments).
For edge_none, caller should ensure requested area lies within Bounds() to avoid undefined behavior (padding is not applied).
Pixel type and number of planes in buffer should match the image’s PixelType() and Planes() (implied by typical dng_pixel_buffer usage; not explicitly stated here).

functions.name: dng_image::Put
functions.description: Writes pixels from the provided pixel buffer into the image at the buffer’s specified area.
requirements: buffer must describe a region within image.Bounds() (no edge padding on Put; implied).
buffer’s pixel type and plane count should match the image’s PixelType() and Planes() (implied).
Caller should not pass overlapping/aliasing buffers that reference the same underlying image memory unless the implementation documents support.

functions.name: dng_image::Trim
functions.description: Shrinks the image bounds to the given rectangle r (i.e., crops the image).
requirements: r must be a subset of current Bounds() ("shrink bounds" is explicitly stated).
Any existing pixel data outside r will be discarded or become inaccessible (behavior depends on implementation).

functions.name: dng_image::Rotate
functions.description: Reorients/rotates the image to match the specified orientation transform.
requirements: orientation must be a valid dng_orientation value representing a supported transform (details not provided).
May change Width/Height/Bounds; callers should not rely on previous geometry after rotation.

functions.name: dng_image::CopyArea
functions.signature: void dng_image::CopyArea(const dng_image &src, const dng_rect &area, uint32 srcPlane, uint32 dstPlane, uint32 planes)
functions.description: Copies a block of pixels from the specified area of src into the same area of this image, copying the given range of planes from srcPlane to dstPlane for planes count.
requirements: area must be within both src.Bounds() and this->Bounds().
srcPlane, dstPlane, and planes must define valid, in-range plane indices for src and destination (srcPlane + planes <= src.Planes(), dstPlane + planes <= this->Planes()).
src and destination pixel types should match (implied).
src and destination areas must correspond exactly (same rectangle coordinates).

functions.name: dng_image::EqualArea
functions.signature: bool dng_image::EqualArea(const dng_image &rhs, const dng_rect &area, uint32 plane, uint32 planes) const
functions.description: Compares a rectangular region across a range of planes in this image against rhs and returns true if they are identical.
requirements: area must be within both images’ Bounds().
plane and planes must be within the valid plane ranges of both images.
Both images should have the same pixel type and comparable storage for the compared planes (implied).

functions.name: dng_image::SetConstant_uint8
functions.description: Fills the specified area of the image with a constant 8-bit unsigned value. Asserts that the image pixel type is ttByte.
requirements: This image’s PixelType() must be ttByte (explicit DNG_ASSERT).
area must be within image.Bounds().

functions.name: dng_image::SetConstant_uint16
functions.description: Fills the specified area of the image with a constant 16-bit unsigned value. Asserts that the image pixel type is ttShort.
requirements: This image’s PixelType() must be ttShort (explicit DNG_ASSERT).
area must be within image.Bounds().

functions.name: dng_image::SetConstant_int16
functions.description: Fills the specified area of the image with a constant 16-bit signed value. Asserts that the image pixel type is ttSShort.
requirements: This image’s PixelType() must be ttSShort (explicit DNG_ASSERT).
area must be within image.Bounds().

functions.name: dng_image::SetConstant_uint32
functions.description: Fills the specified area of the image with a constant 32-bit unsigned value. Asserts that the image pixel type is ttLong.
requirements: This image’s PixelType() must be ttLong (explicit DNG_ASSERT).
area must be within image.Bounds().

functions.name: dng_image::SetConstant_real32
functions.description: Fills the specified area of the image with a constant 32-bit float value. Asserts that the image pixel type is ttFloat.
requirements: This image’s PixelType() must be ttFloat (explicit DNG_ASSERT).
area must be within image.Bounds().

functions.name: dng_image::GetRepeat
functions.signature: virtual void dng_image::GetRepeat(dng_pixel_buffer &buffer, const dng_rect &srcArea, const dng_rect &dstArea) const
functions.description: Copies pixels from srcArea in the image to dstArea in the buffer, repeating the source pattern to cover the destination area. Used to implement edge or pattern replication.
requirements: buffer must be initialized for dstArea with layout compatible with the image.
srcArea must be within image.Bounds(); dstArea must be within the buffer’s addressable region.
Pixel type/planes should match between image and buffer (implied).

functions.name: dng_simple_image::dng_simple_image
functions.signature: dng_simple_image::dng_simple_image(const dng_rect &bounds, uint32 planes, uint32 pixelType, dng_memory_allocator &allocator)
functions.description: Constructs a dng_simple_image with given image bounds, number of planes, and pixel type, using the provided memory allocator. The allocator is stored and used to manage the image’s memory. Use to create a simple dng_image that supports Trim/Rotate and direct pixel buffer access.
requirements: allocator must be a valid dng_memory_allocator reference that remains valid for the entire lifetime of the dng_simple_image instance (the allocator is stored by reference internally).
bounds should describe the intended image area in pixels (exact constraints not documented).
planes is the number of image planes (must be a non-negative integer; exact valid range not documented).
pixelType must be a valid pixel type recognized by the DNG SDK for this image (exact accepted constants not documented).

functions.name: dng_simple_image::~dng_simple_image
functions.description: Destructor for dng_simple_image. Releases resources owned by the image instance and any memory allocated via the associated allocator.
requirements: Do not use the dng_simple_image instance after the destructor has run.
Any pointers or buffers obtained from the image (e.g., via GetPixelBuffer) must not be used after destruction.

functions.name: dng_simple_image::Clone
functions.description: Creates and returns a copy of this image as a dng_image*. Use when a duplicate image object is needed.
requirements: Returns a heap-allocated dng_image pointer; the caller is responsible for ownership and must delete/free it according to the SDK’s conventions to avoid memory leaks (exact ownership semantics not documented but typical for raw pointer return).
May require sufficient memory available via the underlying allocator; handle allocation failures per SDK conventions (not documented here).

functions.name: dng_simple_image::SetPixelType
functions.description: Sets the pixel type for this image. Intended to configure how pixels are represented (e.g., integer depth/format) for subsequent operations.
requirements: pixelType must be a valid pixel type value supported by this image in the DNG SDK (exact set of values not documented).
Should be called in a state where changing pixel type is meaningful for this image; any existing buffers/clients must tolerate the change (specific timing constraints not documented).

functions.name: dng_simple_image::Trim
functions.description: Trims the image by discarding data outside the given rectangle. Memory is not reallocated or freed as part of this operation. Use to crop the image bounds without changing the underlying allocation.
requirements: r should be within the current image bounds; behavior for rectangles outside the current bounds is not documented.
As memory is not reallocated, callers must not assume memory usage will decrease; only the logical image area is reduced.
Any existing views/buffers should be considered with respect to the new bounds after trimming (specific invalidation rules not documented).

functions.name: dng_simple_image::Rotate
functions.description: Rotates (or reorients) the image according to the provided orientation descriptor. Use to apply orientation transforms such as rotations or flips defined by dng_orientation.
requirements: orientation must be a valid dng_orientation value (exact acceptable values not documented).
Callers should expect image bounds and pixel ordering to change according to the orientation (exact details not documented).

functions.name: dng_simple_image::GetPixelBuffer
functions.description: Provides the internal pixel buffer for direct processing by copying the image’s current dng_pixel_buffer state into the caller-supplied buffer. Enables direct access to pixel data unique to dng_simple_image.
requirements: buffer must be a valid reference that the caller can modify/receive into; it will be assigned from the internal buffer.
Any pointers/data inside the returned buffer refer to memory owned by the image; do not free it and do not use it after the image is destroyed.
Use of the buffer should be limited to the lifetime of the dng_simple_image, and concurrent modifications must follow SDK thread-safety rules (not documented here).

functions.name: dng_resolution::dng_resolution
functions.description: Default-constructs an image-resolution record with X/Y resolution and unit. Intended to be filled and passed to image/TIFF writing APIs to tag resolution.
requirements: Object must be populated (fXResolution, fYResolution, fResolutionUnit) before being used by writers that emit resolution tags.

functions.name: tiff_tag::~tiff_tag
functions.description: Virtual destructor for the abstract TIFF tag base class to allow safe polymorphic deletion.
requirements: Destroy only through pointers/references to objects actually created from tiff_tag-derived classes.

functions.name: tiff_tag::Code
functions.description: Returns the TIFF tag ID (code) associated with this tag object.

functions.name: tiff_tag::Type
functions.description: Returns the TIFF tag data type for this tag object.

functions.name: tiff_tag::Count
functions.description: Returns the number of values for this tag.

functions.name: tiff_tag::SetCount
functions.description: Sets the number of values for this tag. Typically used by derived tags when the value count becomes known.
requirements: count must match the actual number of values that Put will write.

functions.name: tiff_tag::Size
functions.description: Computes the data payload size in bytes of the tag (TagTypeSize(Type()) * Count()).
requirements: Type() must be a valid TIFF type supported by TagTypeSize.
Count() must reflect the actual number of elements written by Put.

functions.name: tiff_tag::Put
functions.description: Abstract write of the tag’s value payload to the given stream. Implemented by concrete tag types.
requirements: stream must be open and writable at the expected position.
Derived classes must write exactly Size() bytes and honor Type() and Count().

functions.name: tag_data_ptr::SetData
functions.description: Sets the raw data pointer for a pointer-backed tag.
requirements: data must remain valid and unchanged until Put is called.
The underlying Count() and Type() must match the pointed data layout.

functions.name: tag_data_ptr::Put
functions.description: Writes the pointed-to data for this tag to the stream, using the tag’s Type and Count.
requirements: stream must be open and writable.
fData must be non-null if Count() > 0 and must point to at least Size() bytes.

functions.name: tag_string::tag_string
functions.signature: tag_string::tag_string(uint16 code, const dng_string &s, bool forceASCII = true)
functions.description: Constructs a TIFF ASCII tag from a dng_string. Optionally forces ASCII encoding.
requirements: code must be a TIFF tag ID expecting ASCII.
If forceASCII is true and s contains non-ASCII, behavior depends on implementation (caller should provide ASCII-only when forcing).

functions.name: tag_string::Put
functions.description: Writes the ASCII string value (including required NUL terminator) to the stream.
requirements: stream must be writable.
String data must match Count() and encoding expectations for ASCII tags.

functions.name: tag_encoded_text::tag_encoded_text
functions.description: Constructs a tag holding encoded text (e.g., EXIF UserComment with encoding header).
requirements: code must be appropriate for encoded text/undefined data tags.

functions.name: tag_encoded_text::Put
functions.description: Writes the encoded text payload to the stream, including any required encoding header (implementation-defined).
requirements: stream must be writable.

functions.name: tag_uint8::tag_uint8
functions.description: Constructs an 8-bit unsigned integer TIFF tag with a single value.
requirements: code must identify a tag of type Byte with count 1.

functions.name: tag_uint8::Set
functions.description: Sets the single 8-bit value stored by this tag.

functions.name: tag_uint8_ptr::tag_uint8_ptr
functions.signature: tag_uint8_ptr::tag_uint8_ptr(uint16 code, const uint8 *data, uint32 count = 1)
functions.description: Constructs a TIFF Byte tag that references an external buffer with 'count' bytes.
requirements: data must point to at least count bytes and remain valid until Put.

functions.name: tag_uint16::tag_uint16
functions.description: Constructs a 16-bit unsigned integer TIFF tag with a single value.
requirements: code must identify a tag of type Short with count 1.

functions.name: tag_uint16::Set
functions.description: Sets the single 16-bit unsigned value stored by this tag.

functions.name: tag_int16_ptr::tag_int16_ptr
functions.signature: tag_int16_ptr::tag_int16_ptr(uint16 code, const int16 *data, uint32 count = 1)
functions.description: Constructs a TIFF SShort tag referencing an external array of signed 16-bit integers.
requirements: data must point to at least count int16 values and remain valid until Put.

functions.name: tag_uint16_ptr::tag_uint16_ptr
functions.signature: tag_uint16_ptr::tag_uint16_ptr(uint16 code, const uint16 *data, uint32 count = 1)
functions.description: Constructs a TIFF Short tag referencing an external array of unsigned 16-bit integers.
requirements: data must point to at least count uint16 values and remain valid until Put.

functions.name: tag_uint32::tag_uint32
functions.description: Constructs a 32-bit unsigned integer TIFF tag with a single value.
requirements: code must identify a tag of type Long with count 1.

functions.name: tag_uint32::Set
functions.description: Sets the single 32-bit unsigned value stored by this tag.

functions.name: tag_uint32_ptr::tag_uint32_ptr
functions.signature: tag_uint32_ptr::tag_uint32_ptr(uint16 code, const uint32 *data, uint32 count = 1)
functions.description: Constructs a TIFF Long tag referencing an external array of uint32 values.
requirements: data must point to at least count uint32 values and remain valid until Put.

functions.name: tag_urational::tag_urational
functions.description: Constructs a TIFF Rational tag with a single unsigned rational value.
requirements: value must be a valid dng_urational for the tag.
code must expect type Rational with count 1.

functions.name: tag_urational_ptr::tag_urational_ptr
functions.signature: tag_urational_ptr::tag_urational_ptr(uint16 code, const dng_urational *data = NULL, uint32 count = 1)
functions.description: Constructs a TIFF Rational tag referencing an external array of unsigned rationals.
requirements: If count > 0 then data must point to at least count rationals and remain valid until Put.

functions.name: tag_srational::tag_srational
functions.description: Constructs a TIFF SRational tag with a single signed rational value.
requirements: code must expect type SRational with count 1.

functions.name: tag_srational_ptr::tag_srational_ptr
functions.signature: tag_srational_ptr::tag_srational_ptr(uint16 code, const dng_srational *data = NULL, uint32 count = 1)
functions.description: Constructs a TIFF SRational tag referencing an external array of signed rationals.
requirements: If count > 0 then data must point to at least count rationals and remain valid until Put.

functions.name: tag_real64::tag_real64
functions.description: Constructs a TIFF Double tag with a single 64-bit floating-point value.
requirements: code must expect type Double with count 1.

functions.name: tag_real64::Set
functions.description: Sets the single 64-bit floating-point value stored by this tag.

functions.name: tag_matrix::tag_matrix
functions.description: Constructs a TIFF SRational array tag from a dng_matrix, typically for color matrices.
requirements: m dimensions must not exceed kMaxColorPlanes x kMaxColorPlanes as compiled.
code must correspond to a matrix-compatible tag expecting SRational data.

functions.name: tag_icc_profile::tag_icc_profile
functions.description: Constructs a tag that encapsulates an ICC profile blob for embedding in TIFF/DNG.
requirements: If profileSize > 0, profileData must point to at least profileSize bytes and remain valid until Put.

functions.name: tag_cfa_pattern::tag_cfa_pattern
functions.signature: tag_cfa_pattern::tag_cfa_pattern(uint16 code, uint32 rows, uint32 cols, const uint8 *pattern)
functions.description: Constructs a CFA pattern tag (ttUndefined) containing row/column counts and the pattern bytes.
requirements: pattern must point to at least rows*cols bytes and remain valid until Put.
rows and cols must match the underlying CFA pattern dimensions.

functions.name: tag_cfa_pattern::Put
functions.description: Writes the CFA pattern payload: a header (rows, cols) followed by rows*cols pattern bytes.
requirements: stream must be writable.
pattern must be non-null for non-zero rows*cols.

functions.name: tag_exif_date_time::tag_exif_date_time
functions.description: Constructs an EXIF date/time ASCII tag from a dng_date_time (formatted "YYYY:MM:DD HH:MM:SS").
requirements: code must correspond to an EXIF date/time tag expecting ASCII.

functions.name: tag_iptc::tag_iptc
functions.description: Constructs an IPTC/NAA tag from a raw data block.
requirements: If length > 0, data must point to at least length bytes and remain valid until Put.

functions.name: tag_iptc::Put
functions.description: Writes the IPTC data block to the stream.
requirements: stream must be writable.
If length > 0, internal data pointer must be valid for length bytes.

functions.name: tag_xmp::tag_xmp
functions.description: Constructs a tag that writes serialized XMP metadata into the file. Allocates an internal buffer to hold the packet.
requirements: xmp may be null to produce no tag, or must point to a valid dng_xmp instance if used (details depend on implementation).

functions.name: dng_tiff_directory::dng_tiff_directory
functions.description: Constructs an empty TIFF IFD directory container for tag entries and an optional chained IFD offset.

functions.name: dng_tiff_directory::~dng_tiff_directory
functions.description: Destructor for the TIFF directory container.

functions.name: dng_tiff_directory::Add
functions.description: Adds a tag pointer to this TIFF directory (up to an internal maximum).
requirements: tag must remain valid until the directory is written (Put).
At most kMaxEntries (100) entries can be added.

functions.name: dng_tiff_directory::SetChained
functions.description: Sets the offset to a chained (next) IFD to be written after this directory.
requirements: offset must be the correct byte offset relative to the chosen base when calling Put.

functions.name: dng_tiff_directory::Size
functions.description: Returns the total size in bytes that writing this directory (and its chained directory pointer) will consume.
requirements: Relies on the current set of tag entries and their sizes.

functions.name: dng_tiff_directory::Put
functions.signature: void dng_tiff_directory::Put(dng_stream &stream, OffsetsBase offsetsBase = offsetsRelativeToStream, uint32 explicitBase = 0) const
functions.description: Writes the IFD (directory entries, values/offsets, and optional chained offset) to the stream. Offsets can be interpreted relative to the stream, an explicit base, or the IFD.
requirements: stream must be writable.
If offsetsBase == offsetsRelativeToExplicitBase, explicitBase must be set appropriately.
All added tags must supply valid Type/Count/Size and Put implementations.

functions.name: dng_basic_tag_set::dng_basic_tag_set
functions.description: Populates a TIFF directory with the basic image tags (dimensions, tiling/strips, samples, compression/predictor, etc.) derived from the provided IFD.
requirements: directory must outlive this tag set usage/writing.
info must describe the image correctly (dimensions, bits per sample, tiling layout).

functions.name: dng_basic_tag_set::~dng_basic_tag_set
functions.description: Destructor for the basic tag set helper.

functions.name: dng_basic_tag_set::SetTileOffset
functions.description: Sets the file offset for a specific tile/strip entry in the directory.
requirements: index must be within the number of tiles/strips configured in the basic tag set.
offset must be computed relative to the file start as expected by TIFF offsets.

functions.name: dng_basic_tag_set::SetTileByteCount
functions.description: Sets the byte count for a specific tile/strip entry in the directory.
requirements: index must be within range of tile/strip count.
count must match the actual number of bytes written for that tile/strip.

functions.name: dng_basic_tag_set::WritingStrips
functions.description: Returns true if the basic tag set is configured for strips instead of tiles.

functions.name: exif_tag_set::exif_tag_set
functions.signature: exif_tag_set::exif_tag_set(dng_tiff_directory &directory, const dng_exif &exif, bool makerNoteSafe = false, const void *makerNoteData = NULL, uint32 makerNoteLength = 0, bool insideDNG = false)
functions.description: Builds EXIF and GPS IFDs based on provided EXIF metadata and links them into the given directory. Optionally supplies maker note data and controls safety/inside-DNG behavior.
requirements: directory must remain valid through writing.
exif must contain the metadata to mirror into EXIF/GPS tags.
If makerNoteLength > 0, makerNoteData must point to at least that many bytes and remain valid until written.

functions.name: exif_tag_set::Locate
functions.description: Sets the file offset where the EXIF IFD will be written and computes the GPS IFD offset as EXIF offset plus EXIF IFD size.
requirements: offset must be a valid target position where EXIF IFD will be written.

functions.name: exif_tag_set::Size
functions.description: Returns the combined size in bytes of the EXIF and GPS IFDs.

functions.name: exif_tag_set::Put
functions.description: Writes the EXIF and GPS IFDs to the stream in sequence.
requirements: stream must be writable.
Locate should be called (or equivalent linking performed) so offsets are correct before writing.

functions.name: exif_tag_set::AddLinks
functions.description: Adds the ExifIFD and GPS IFD link tags to the provided directory so that readers can locate EXIF/GPS metadata.
requirements: directory must be valid and is typically the main IFD that will reference the EXIF/GPS IFDs.

functions.name: tiff_dng_extended_color_profile::tiff_dng_extended_color_profile
functions.description: Prepares a TIFF/DNG extended color profile IFD from a dng_camera_profile.
requirements: profile must remain valid for the lifetime of this object until writing.

functions.name: tiff_dng_extended_color_profile::Put
functions.description: Writes the extended color profile structure to the stream, optionally including a model restriction tag.
requirements: stream must be writable.

functions.name: tag_dng_noise_profile::tag_dng_noise_profile
functions.description: Constructs a tag encoding a DNG NoiseProfile (pairs of coefficients, one per plane) for embedding in metadata.
requirements: profile must contain no more than kMaxColorPlanes entries as compiled.

functions.name: dng_image_writer::dng_image_writer
functions.description: Constructs an image writer capable of writing images as TIFF/DNG and encoding previews.

functions.name: dng_image_writer::~dng_image_writer
functions.description: Destructor for the image writer.

functions.name: dng_image_writer::EncodeJPEGPreview
functions.signature: virtual void dng_image_writer::EncodeJPEGPreview(dng_host &host, const dng_image &image, dng_jpeg_preview &preview, int32 quality = -1)
functions.description: Encodes a JPEG preview from the given image into the provided preview container, with optional quality control.
requirements: host must be valid for memory/progress callbacks.
image must be initialized and readable.
preview must be a valid output container to receive the JPEG.
quality of -1 lets implementation choose; otherwise must be in the accepted JPEG quality range (implementation-defined).

functions.name: dng_image_writer::WriteImage
functions.signature: virtual void dng_image_writer::WriteImage(dng_host &host, const dng_ifd &ifd, dng_basic_tag_set &basic, dng_stream &stream, const dng_image &image, uint32 fakeChannels = 1)
functions.description: Writes the actual pixel data for a single IFD setup to the stream, updating tile/strip offsets and sizes via the provided basic tag set. Supports a fakeChannels parameter for derived-channel cases.
requirements: host must be valid.
ifd must describe the image/tile layout correctly.
basic must already be added to a directory and will be updated with offsets/counts.
stream must be writable and positioned appropriately.
image must match the ifd described layout and sample format.
fakeChannels must be >= 1.

functions.name: dng_image_writer::WriteTIFF
functions.signature: void dng_image_writer::WriteTIFF(dng_host &host, dng_stream &stream, const dng_image &image, uint32 photometricInterpretation, uint32 compression, dng_negative *negative, const dng_color_space *space = NULL, const dng_resolution *resolution = NULL, const dng_jpeg_preview *thumbnail = NULL, const dng_memory_block *imageResources = NULL, dng_metadata_subset metadataSubset = kMetadataSubset_All)
functions.description: Writes a TIFF image to the stream from a dng_image, optionally embedding metadata from a dng_negative, an ICC profile (from color space), resolution, a JPEG thumbnail, and image resources.
requirements: host and stream must be valid and stream writable.
image must be initialized and compatible with photometricInterpretation.
compression must be ccUncompressed per comment.
negative may be null; if non-null it supplies EXIF/IPTC/XMP.
space may be null; if non-null and it has an ICC profile, it will be tagged (no color conversion).
resolution, thumbnail, imageResources are optional; if provided they must be valid.
metadataSubset controls which metadata to include.

functions.name: dng_image_writer::WriteTIFF
functions.signature: void dng_image_writer::WriteTIFF(dng_host &host, dng_stream &stream, const dng_image &image, uint32 photometricInterpretation = piBlackIsZero, uint32 compression = ccUncompressed, const dng_metadata *metadata = NULL, const dng_color_space *space = NULL, const dng_resolution *resolution = NULL, const dng_jpeg_preview *thumbnail = NULL, const dng_memory_block *imageResources = NULL, dng_metadata_subset metadataSubset = kMetadataSubset_All)
functions.description: Writes a TIFF image to the stream from a dng_image, optionally embedding provided metadata, ICC profile (from color space), resolution, a JPEG thumbnail, and image resources.
requirements: host and stream must be valid and stream writable.
image must be initialized and compatible with photometricInterpretation.
compression must be ccUncompressed per comment.
metadata may be null; if non-null it supplies EXIF/IPTC/XMP.
space/resolution/thumbnail/imageResources are optional; if provided they must be valid.
metadataSubset controls which metadata to include.

functions.name: dng_image_writer::WriteTIFFWithProfile
functions.signature: void dng_image_writer::WriteTIFFWithProfile(dng_host &host, dng_stream &stream, const dng_image &image, uint32 photometricInterpretation, uint32 compression, dng_negative *negative, const void *profileData = NULL, uint32 profileSize = 0, const dng_resolution *resolution = NULL, const dng_jpeg_preview *thumbnail = NULL, const dng_memory_block *imageResources = NULL, dng_metadata_subset metadataSubset = kMetadataSubset_All)
functions.description: Writes a TIFF image with an explicitly supplied ICC profile blob (profileData/profileSize), using metadata from a dng_negative.
requirements: host/stream must be valid and writable.
image must be initialized and compatible with photometricInterpretation.
compression must be ccUncompressed per comment.
negative may be null; if non-null it supplies metadata.
If profileSize > 0, profileData must point to at least profileSize bytes and remain valid during write.
Optional resolution/thumbnail/imageResources must be valid if provided.
metadataSubset controls metadata inclusion.

functions.name: dng_image_writer::WriteTIFFWithProfile
functions.signature: virtual void dng_image_writer::WriteTIFFWithProfile(dng_host &host, dng_stream &stream, const dng_image &image, uint32 photometricInterpretation = piBlackIsZero, uint32 compression = ccUncompressed, const dng_metadata *metadata = NULL, const void *profileData = NULL, uint32 profileSize = 0, const dng_resolution *resolution = NULL, const dng_jpeg_preview *thumbnail = NULL, const dng_memory_block *imageResources = NULL, dng_metadata_subset metadataSubset = kMetadataSubset_All)
functions.description: Writes a TIFF image with an explicitly supplied ICC profile blob (profileData/profileSize), using a generic metadata block.
requirements: host/stream must be valid and writable.

functions.description: Applies the gain map to the specified destination area of the provided pixel buffer, honoring the image bounds. Intended to be called by the processing pipeline, potentially from multiple threads.

The associated gain map and area spec must be valid (inferred).

functions.name: dng_mosaic_info::dng_mosaic_info
functions.description: Default constructor for dng_mosaic_info. Initializes an instance that will later be populated (e.g., via Parse/PostParse) with CFA/mosaic metadata describing a DNG’s color filter array layout.
requirements: Object is uninitialized with respect to file-specific CFA data until Parse/PostParse are called.

functions.name: dng_mosaic_info::~dng_mosaic_info
functions.description: Virtual destructor. Allows safe destruction via base-class pointers and releases any resources owned by dng_mosaic_info (if any).

functions.name: dng_mosaic_info::Parse
functions.description: Parses mosaic/CFA-related metadata from a DNG input. Uses the host for allocations/cancellation/progress, reads from the provided stream, and consults dng_info for previously parsed file metadata. Populates fields such as fCFAPatternSize, fCFAPattern, fColorPlanes, fCFAPlaneColor, fCFALayout, fBayerGreenSplit, and related sizes.
requirements: host must be a valid dng_host instance capable of servicing allocation and status callbacks.
stream must be initialized and positioned to read the DNG’s mosaic/CFA-related tags and structures required by this implementation.
info must describe the same input DNG and be initialized from prior parsing steps.
Must be called before PostParse and before using methods that depend on parsed mosaic data (e.g., DownScale, Interpolate, DstSize).

functions.name: dng_mosaic_info::PostParse
functions.description: Performs post-parse setup or adjustments for mosaic/CFA interpretation based on the parsed data and the target negative. Typically finalizes sizes, aspect ratio, and any layout-dependent flags after initial Parse.
requirements: Must be called after a successful Parse on the same object.
host must be a valid dng_host for any required allocations or progress callbacks.
negative must correspond to the same mosaiced DNG being processed and be initialized.

functions.name: dng_mosaic_info::IsColorFilterArray
functions.description: Returns true if the DNG source uses a color filter array (mosaiced) source. Implemented as fCFAPatternSize != dng_point(0, 0).

functions.name: dng_mosaic_info::SetFourColorBayer
functions.description: Enables generation of four-plane output from a three-plane Bayer input by splitting the green channel into two planes (one from each Bayer green sampling grid). Useful for evaluating BayerGreenSplit. Returns true if four-color output is enabled/supported for the current pattern; false otherwise.
requirements: Should only be called for Bayer-pattern CFA data; behavior for non-Bayer patterns may be unsupported or return false.

functions.name: dng_mosaic_info::FullScale
functions.description: Returns the integer scaling factors (horizontal and vertical) relative to the input mosaic size required to hold the full demosaiced output. Accounts for layouts (e.g., staggered/rotated) that expand output dimensions.

functions.name: dng_mosaic_info::DownScale
functions.signature: virtual dng_point dng_mosaic_info::DownScale(uint32 minSize, uint32 prefSize, real64 cropFactor) const;
functions.description: Computes integer downsampling factors for mosaic data so the demosaiced image’s longer dimension is as close to prefSize as possible but not smaller than minSize, considering the fraction of the image used after cropping (cropFactor). Returns a dng_point with horizontal and vertical integer factors.
requirements: minSize specifies the minimum allowed longer dimension of the downsampled image (must be a non-negative integer; zero permits any reduction).
prefSize specifies the target longer dimension (should be >= minSize per the description).
cropFactor specifies the fraction of the image to be used after cropping; must be in a sensible range for a fraction (typically 0.0–1.0 as implied by description).
For safest results, use the returned value directly with DstSize and Interpolate.

functions.name: dng_mosaic_info::DstSize
functions.description: Returns the demosaiced destination image size for a given integer downsampling factor. Intended to be used with a downScale value previously obtained from DownScale.
requirements: downScale should be the value returned by DownScale for the same object and parameters, or otherwise be a valid non-zero positive integer factor per axis for this mosaic (i.e., one that the implementation accepts).
Object must have been initialized via Parse/PostParse so that source size and layout are known.

functions.name: dng_mosaic_info::InterpolateGeneric
functions.signature: virtual void dng_mosaic_info::InterpolateGeneric(dng_host &host, dng_negative &negative, const dng_image &srcImage, dng_image &dstImage, uint32 srcPlane = 0) const;
functions.description: Performs demosaic interpolation of a single plane in the non-downsampled case. Uses the host for allocations/cancellation/progress, reads mosaic samples from srcImage, and writes interpolated samples to dstImage. srcPlane selects which plane to interpolate when splitting or handling multi-plane mosaics.
requirements: host must be valid for allocations and callbacks.
negative must correspond to the same mosaiced data and be initialized.
srcImage must contain the mosaiced source data consistent with this dng_mosaic_info (pattern, layout, sizes).
dstImage must be allocated/ready to receive the interpolated plane at the correct destination size (e.g., DstSize with downScale = (1,1)).
srcPlane must be a valid plane index for the current mosaic configuration (typically < fColorPlanes or per split-green behavior).
Call after Parse/PostParse so mosaic parameters are known.

functions.name: dng_mosaic_info::InterpolateFast
functions.signature: virtual void dng_mosaic_info::InterpolateFast(dng_host &host, dng_negative &negative, const dng_image &srcImage, dng_image &dstImage, const dng_point &downScale, uint32 srcPlane = 0) const;
functions.description: Performs demosaic interpolation of a single plane for the downsampled case. Subsamples the mosaic according to downScale and writes the interpolated result to dstImage. Intended for speed when downscaling.
requirements: host must be valid for allocations and callbacks.
negative must correspond to the same mosaiced data and be initialized.
downScale must be a valid integer subsampling factor per axis for this mosaic (e.g., one produced by DownScale).
srcImage must contain mosaiced source data compatible with this dng_mosaic_info.
dstImage must be sized appropriately for DstSize(downScale).
srcPlane must be a valid plane index for the current mosaic configuration.
Call after Parse/PostParse so mosaic parameters are known.

functions.name: dng_mosaic_info::Interpolate
functions.signature: virtual void dng_mosaic_info::Interpolate(dng_host &host, dng_negative &negative, const dng_image &srcImage, dng_image &dstImage, const dng_point &downScale, uint32 srcPlane = 0) const;
functions.description: Dispatches demosaic interpolation of a single plane, choosing between the generic (non-downsampled) and fast (downsampled) implementations based on parameters. Uses host for allocations/cancellation/progress.
requirements: host must be valid for allocations and callbacks.
negative must correspond to the same mosaiced data and be initialized.
downScale should be the factor obtained from DownScale; use (1,1) for non-downsampled interpolation.
srcImage must contain mosaiced source data compatible with this dng_mosaic_info.
dstImage must be sized appropriately for the chosen downScale (see DstSize).
srcPlane must be a valid plane index for the current mosaic configuration.
Call after Parse/PostParse so mosaic parameters are known.

requirements: offset should be non-negative for the model to be valid (IsValid requires offset >= 0).

functions.name: dng_noise_function::IsValid
functions.description: Reports whether the noise function parameters form a valid model (scale > 0 and offset >= 0).

functions.name: dng_noise_profile::dng_noise_profile
functions.description: Default-constructs an empty noise profile. Per comments, an empty profile is invalid until populated with 1 or N plane-specific noise functions.

functions.name: dng_noise_profile::dng_noise_profile
functions.description: Constructs a noise profile from a vector of noise functions. By convention, the profile is valid only if the number of functions is 1 or equals the number of color planes in the negative it is associated with.
requirements: Each dng_noise_function supplied should itself be valid (IsValid()==true) for meaningful results.
When used with a negative, the count of functions should be either 1 or equal to that negative’s number of color planes.

functions.name: dng_noise_profile::IsValid
functions.description: Returns whether the profile is internally valid (1 or N functions for some N>0). Exact validation logic is not shown here; see IsValidForNegative for per-negative checks.

functions.name: dng_noise_profile::IsValidForNegative
functions.description: Checks whether this profile is valid for a specific negative: it must contain either 1 function (applies to all planes) or N functions where N equals the negative’s number of color planes.
requirements: negative must be a valid dng_negative instance with a defined number of color channels.
Profile must contain either 1 function or exactly negative.ColorChannels() functions.

functions.name: dng_noise_profile::NoiseFunction
functions.description: Returns the noise function for the specified plane. If the profile has 1 function, conceptually that function applies to all planes.
requirements: plane must be a valid index into the stored function array. If NumFunctions()==1, the only valid index is 0 (details of broader aliasing are not specified here).
The returned noise function should be used only if it is valid (IsValid()==true).

functions.name: dng_noise_profile::NumFunctions
functions.description: Returns the number of noise functions contained in this profile.

functions.name: dng_metadata::dng_metadata
functions.description: Constructs a metadata container associated with a DNG host. Initializes internal EXIF/XMP/IPTC containers and state for subsequent population and synchronization.
requirements: host must remain valid for the lifetime of the dng_metadata instance if the implementation consults it beyond construction (lifetime coupling is not explicitly documented).
No side effects beyond initializing internal members are guaranteed by the header; actual allocation/initialization details are implementation-defined.

functions.name: dng_metadata::dng_metadata
functions.description: Copy-constructs a metadata object from rhs using the provided allocator for internal heap objects. Intended to duplicate EXIF/IPTC/XMP and related state.
requirements: allocator must outlive any allocations performed for this dng_metadata during construction.
rhs must remain valid for the duration of the copy operation; after construction, the new object owns its own copies.

functions.name: dng_metadata::~dng_metadata
functions.description: Destroys the metadata object and releases any owned memory blocks and sub-objects (EXIF, XMP, MakerNote, IPTC, etc.).
requirements: All pointers returned from this object that transfer ownership (if any) must be properly released by the caller before destruction. No other explicit caller requirements.

functions.name: dng_metadata::Clone
functions.description: Creates a deep copy of this metadata using the provided allocator. Useful for creating a modifiable copy of metadata.
requirements: allocator must remain valid for the lifetime of allocations made during cloning.
Caller owns the returned pointer and must manage its lifetime according to the SDK’s allocation/ownership model (typically delete via matching allocator or owning wrapper).

functions.name: dng_metadata::SetBaseOrientation
functions.description: Sets the base orientation for both thumbnail and raw data. Typically derived from EXIF.
requirements: orientation must represent a valid dng_orientation value.

functions.name: dng_metadata::HasBaseOrientation
functions.description: Returns true if a base orientation has been set.

functions.name: dng_metadata::BaseOrientation
functions.description: Returns the current base orientation reference.
requirements: HasBaseOrientation() should be true before dereferencing the semantics of the returned value; otherwise it may be a default-initialized orientation.

functions.name: dng_metadata::ApplyOrientation
functions.description: Logically rotates the image by updating the stored orientation values and synchronizes that change into XMP.
requirements: orientation must be a valid dng_orientation.
If XMP is present, it will be updated; callers should be prepared for metadata changes affecting downstream processing.

functions.name: dng_metadata::SetIPTC
functions.description: Sets IPTC data from a caller-provided memory block and records its original file offset.
requirements: Ownership of block is transferred to the metadata object; after the call, block is reset/released.
offset is recorded as provided; no range requirements stated.
block must point to a valid IPTC data buffer.

functions.name: dng_metadata::SetIPTC
functions.description: Sets IPTC data from a caller-provided memory block without recording a source offset.
requirements: Ownership of block is transferred to the metadata object; after the call, block is reset/released.
block must point to a valid IPTC data buffer.

functions.name: dng_metadata::ClearIPTC
functions.description: Clears any stored IPTC data and resets related state.

functions.name: dng_metadata::IPTCData
functions.description: Returns a raw pointer to the IPTC data buffer, or NULL if none.
requirements: Returned pointer remains valid only as long as the dng_metadata object (and its IPTC block) remain unchanged.
Do not write through this pointer (const data).

functions.name: dng_metadata::IPTCLength
functions.description: Returns the byte length of the current IPTC data (0 if none).

functions.name: dng_metadata::IPTCOffset
functions.description: Returns the original file offset of the IPTC block if known; unspecified if none was set.

functions.name: dng_metadata::IPTCDigest
functions.description: Computes and returns an MD5-like fingerprint for the IPTC block. Padding bytes can be included or excluded from the digest.
requirements: If includePadding is true, padding bytes are part of the digest; otherwise they are excluded. No further caller requirements.

functions.name: dng_metadata::RebuildIPTC
functions.description: Re-serializes IPTC data into a fresh memory block using the supplied allocator, optionally padding for TIFF requirements.
requirements: allocator must remain valid during the rebuild process.
If padForTIFF is true, caller expects IPTC block suitable for TIFF embedding.

functions.name: dng_metadata::SetMakerNoteSafety
functions.description: Marks whether the MakerNote block is safe to copy between files unchanged.

functions.name: dng_metadata::IsMakerNoteSafe
functions.description: Returns whether the MakerNote is marked safe to copy.

functions.name: dng_metadata::SetMakerNote
functions.description: Sets the MakerNote data from a caller-supplied block, transferring ownership.
requirements: Ownership of block is transferred to the metadata object; after the call, block is reset/released.
block must refer to a valid MakerNote payload for the target file/camera if it will be used downstream.

functions.name: dng_metadata::ClearMakerNote
functions.description: Clears MakerNote data and resets the safety flag to false.

functions.name: dng_metadata::MakerNoteData
functions.description: Returns a raw pointer to the MakerNote data block, or NULL if none.
requirements: Pointer validity is tied to the lifetime of the dng_metadata object and until MakerNote is modified.
Data is read-only via this API.

functions.name: dng_metadata::MakerNoteLength
functions.description: Returns the length in bytes of the MakerNote data (0 if none).

functions.name: dng_metadata::GetExif
functions.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the EXIF object, or NULL if none has been set/created.
requirements: Caller must check for NULL before dereferencing.
Returned pointer remains owned by dng_metadata; do not delete it.

functions.name: dng_metadata::GetExif
functions.description: Returns a const pointer to the EXIF object, or NULL if none has been set/created.
requirements: Caller must check for NULL before dereferencing.
Pointer remains valid as long as the dng_metadata object isn’t modified to reset EXIF.

functions.name: dng_metadata::Exif
functions.description: Returns a reference to the EXIF object cast to the requested concrete EXIF subclass type E. Throws if EXIF is NULL or if the dynamic type is not E.
requirements: GetExif() must return non-NULL; otherwise Throws via ThrowProgramError("EXIF object is NULL.").
E must be the dynamic type of the EXIF object (or a type that dynamic_cast< E & > can bind to); otherwise a bad_cast will be thrown at runtime.
Caller must include/link RTTI for dynamic_cast to function.

functions.name: dng_metadata::Exif
functions.signature: template <class E> const E & dng_metadata::Exif () const
functions.description: Const-qualified variant returning a const reference to the EXIF object cast to concrete type E. Throws if EXIF is NULL or the cast fails.
requirements: GetExif() must return non-NULL; otherwise Throws via ThrowProgramError("EXIF object is NULL.").
E must match the EXIF object's dynamic type for dynamic_cast to succeed; otherwise bad_cast is thrown.
RTTI must be enabled.

functions.name: dng_metadata::Exif
functions.description: Duplicate entry in the request list; see the earlier template overload entry for details.
requirements: See requirements listed for the non-const template Exif<E>() above.

functions.name: dng_metadata::Exif
functions.signature: template <class E> const E & dng_metadata::Exif () const
functions.description: Duplicate entry in the request list; see the earlier const template overload entry for details.
requirements: See requirements listed for the const template Exif<E>() above.

functions.name: dng_metadata::ResetExif
functions.description: Replaces the current EXIF object pointer with newExif (takes ownership).
requirements: newExif must have been allocated appropriately for ownership by dng_metadata; the object will be managed and destroyed by dng_metadata.
Any existing EXIF object held by dng_metadata will be released.

functions.name: dng_metadata::BuildExifBlock
functions.signature: dng_memory_block * dng_metadata::BuildExifBlock (dng_memory_allocator &allocator, const dng_resolution *resolution = NULL, bool includeIPTC = false, const dng_jpeg_preview *thumbnail = NULL) const
functions.description: Serializes EXIF (and optionally IPTC and thumbnail) metadata to a contiguous memory block using the allocator. Intended for writing to files.
requirements: allocator must remain valid for any allocations performed during block creation.
If resolution is non-NULL, it is used to populate resolution-related EXIF tags.
If includeIPTC is true, current IPTC data (if any) is embedded.
If thumbnail is non-NULL, it is embedded in the EXIF block per implementation.
Caller owns the returned memory block and must free/manage it via the corresponding allocator mechanisms.

functions.name: dng_metadata::GetOriginalExif
functions.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the original (pre-synchronization) EXIF object, or NULL if not present.
requirements: Caller must check for NULL before use.
Ownership remains with dng_metadata.

functions.name: dng_metadata::GetOriginalExif
functions.description: Returns a const pointer to the original EXIF object, or NULL if not present.
requirements: Caller must check for NULL.
Pointer validity is tied to the lifecycle of the dng_metadata object.

functions.name: dng_metadata::SetXMP
functions.signature: bool dng_metadata::SetXMP (dng_host &host, const void *buffer, uint32 count, bool xmpInSidecar = false, bool xmpIsNewer = false)
functions.description: Parses and sets the XMP packet from a raw buffer. Records whether it originated from a sidecar and whether it is newer than the raw file.
requirements: Available only when qDNGUseXMP is enabled at compile time.
buffer must point to a buffer of size count bytes containing an XMP packet.
host must be valid for any parsing/normalization work performed.
Returns true on success; false on parse/validation failure.

functions.name: dng_metadata::SetEmbeddedXMP
functions.signature: void dng_metadata::SetEmbeddedXMP (dng_host &host, const void *buffer, uint32 count)
functions.description: Sets the embedded XMP block from a raw buffer and updates the EmbeddedXMPDigest.
requirements: Available only when qDNGUseXMP is enabled at compile time.
buffer/count must reference a valid XMP packet.
host must be valid for any processing performed.

functions.name: dng_metadata::GetXMP
functions.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the XMP object, or NULL if none present.
requirements: Available only when qDNGUseXMP is enabled at compile time.
Caller must check for NULL before use. Ownership remains with dng_metadata.

functions.name: dng_metadata::GetXMP
functions.description: Returns a const pointer to the XMP object, or NULL if none present.
requirements: Available only when qDNGUseXMP is enabled at compile time.
Caller must check for NULL before use. Pointer remains owned by dng_metadata.

functions.name: dng_metadata::XMP
functions.description: Returns a reference to the XMP object cast to concrete type X. Throws if XMP is NULL or the cast fails.
requirements: Available only when qDNGUseXMP is enabled at compile time.
GetXMP() must return non-NULL; otherwise Throws via ThrowProgramError("XMP object is NULL.").
X must match the dynamic type of the underlying XMP object; otherwise dynamic_cast to reference will throw std::bad_cast.
RTTI must be enabled.

functions.name: dng_metadata::XMP
functions.signature: template <class X> const X & dng_metadata::XMP () const
functions.description: Const-qualified variant returning a const reference to the XMP object cast to type X. Throws if XMP is NULL or cast fails.
requirements: Available only when qDNGUseXMP is enabled at compile time.
GetXMP() must return non-NULL; otherwise Throws via ThrowProgramError("XMP object is NULL.").
X must match the dynamic type of the underlying XMP object; otherwise dynamic_cast throws std::bad_cast.
RTTI must be enabled.

functions.name: dng_metadata::XMP
functions.description: Duplicate entry in the request list; see the earlier template overload entry for details.
requirements: See requirements listed for the non-const template XMP<X>() above.

functions.name: dng_metadata::XMP
functions.signature: template <class X> const X & dng_metadata::XMP () const
functions.description: Duplicate entry in the request list; see the earlier const template overload entry for details.
requirements: See requirements listed for the const template XMP<X>() above.

functions.name: dng_metadata::XMPinSidecar
functions.description: Indicates whether the XMP was read from a sidecar file.
requirements: Available only when qDNGUseXMP is enabled at compile time.

functions.name: dng_metadata::EmbeddedXMPDigest
functions.description: Returns the fingerprint (digest) of the embedded XMP, if any.
requirements: Available only when qDNGUseXMP is enabled at compile time.
Digest validity can be checked via HaveValidEmbeddedXMP().

functions.name: dng_metadata::HaveValidEmbeddedXMP
functions.description: Returns true if a valid embedded XMP block is present (digest is valid).
requirements: Available only when qDNGUseXMP is enabled at compile time.

functions.name: dng_metadata::ResetXMP
functions.description: Replaces the current XMP object with newXMP (takes ownership).
requirements: Available only when qDNGUseXMP is enabled at compile time.
newXMP must be allocated appropriately; ownership transfers to dng_metadata.
Any previously held XMP object will be released.

functions.name: dng_metadata::ResetXMPSidecarNewer
functions.signature: void dng_metadata::ResetXMPSidecarNewer (dng_xmp * newXMP, bool inSidecar, bool isNewer)
functions.description: Replaces the current XMP object and records sidecar/newer flags in one call.
requirements: Available only when qDNGUseXMP is enabled at compile time.
Ownership of newXMP transfers to dng_metadata.

functions.name: dng_metadata::SynchronizeMetadata
functions.description: Synchronizes overlapping fields across EXIF, IPTC, and XMP according to SDK policies.
requirements: If both EXIF and XMP are present, values may be propagated or reconciled; callers should avoid concurrent modification during this call.

functions.name: dng_metadata::UpdateDateTime
functions.description: Updates date/time metadata fields in EXIF and XMP to the specified value.
requirements: dt must contain a valid date/time per SDK expectations.
XMP must be enabled/present to reflect changes in XMP; EXIF must be present to reflect changes there.

functions.name: dng_metadata::UpdateDateTimeToNow
functions.description: Updates EXIF and XMP date/time fields to the current time.
requirements: Relies on system time; behavior depends on environment and host.

functions.name: dng_metadata::UpdateMetadataDateTimeToNow
functions.description: Updates the XMP MetadataDate (and related) field(s) to the current time.
requirements: Available only when qDNGUseXMP is enabled at compile time; affects XMP.

functions.name: dng_metadata::SetSourceMIMI
functions.description: Sets the source file MIME type string (typoed as MIMI in the API).
requirements: s must be a NUL-terminated string; it is copied into internal storage.

functions.name: dng_metadata::SourceMIMI
functions.description: Returns the stored source MIME type string.

functions.name: dng_negative::~dng_negative
functions.description: Virtual destructor for the negative object; releases owned images, profiles, and metadata sub-objects.

functions.name: dng_negative::Make
functions.description: Factory method that constructs a dng_negative using the given host. May return a subclass instance depending on host.
requirements: Caller owns the returned pointer and must manage its lifetime appropriately.

functions.name: dng_negative::Allocator
functions.description: Returns a reference to the memory allocator associated with this negative.
requirements: The returned allocator reference remains valid as long as the dng_negative remains alive; the allocator’s lifetime must outlive the negative per class documentation.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetModelName
functions.description: Sets the non-localized ASCII model name string.
requirements: name must be a NUL-terminated ASCII string; it is copied internally.

functions.name: dng_negative::ModelName
functions.description: Returns the non-localized ASCII model name.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetLocalName
functions.description: Sets the localized UTF-8 model name string.
requirements: name must be a NUL-terminated UTF-8 string; it is copied internally.

functions.name: dng_negative::LocalName
functions.description: Returns the localized UTF-8 model name.

functions.name: dng_negative::Metadata
functions.description: Returns a mutable reference to the internal metadata object.
requirements: When qMetadataOnConst == 0 (as in this header), only non-const negatives expose metadata via this accessor to avoid accessing embedded data on const objects.

functions.name: dng_negative::CloneInternalMetadata
functions.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of the negative’s internal metadata, typically as a basis for modification without altering the original.
requirements: Caller owns the returned pointer and must manage its lifetime appropriately.
Requires sufficient memory via the negative’s allocator as used internally.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetBaseOrientation
functions.description: Convenience wrapper that forwards to Metadata().SetBaseOrientation().
requirements: Same requirements as dng_metadata::SetBaseOrientation.

functions.name: dng_negative::HasBaseOrientation
functions.description: Returns whether base orientation has been set. For const-ness, exposure depends on qMetadataOnConst.
requirements: Behavior reflects Metadata().HasBaseOrientation().

functions.name: dng_negative::BaseOrientation
functions.description: Returns the base orientation from internal metadata. For const-ness, exposure depends on qMetadataOnConst.
requirements: HasBaseOrientation() should be true to rely on returned value semantics.

functions.name: dng_negative::ComputeOrientation
functions.description: Hook for SDK host code to compute additional rotations based on metadata; default implementation typically returns metadata.BaseOrientation().
requirements: metadata must be valid; implementers may override to apply custom orientation logic.

functions.name: dng_negative::Orientation
functions.description: Returns the effective orientation by invoking ComputeOrientation on the current internal Metadata().
requirements: Only callable on non-const negatives when qMetadataOnConst == 0 (as in this header).

functions.name: dng_negative::ApplyOrientation
functions.description: Applies a logical rotation to the image by updating orientation values within metadata (also updates XMP).
requirements: Same requirements as dng_metadata::ApplyOrientation.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetDefaultCropSize
functions.description: Sets the default crop size (width/height) in pixels as rationals.
requirements: sizeH and sizeV should represent non-negative, sensible sizes for the source image.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetDefaultCropSize
functions.description: Convenience overload to set default crop size using integer pixel dimensions.
requirements: sizeH and sizeV are pixel counts; should be non-zero and sensible for the image dimensions.

functions.name: dng_negative::DefaultCropSizeH
functions.description: Returns the default crop width as a rational.

functions.name: dng_negative::DefaultCropSizeV
functions.description: Returns the default crop height as a rational.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetDefaultCropOrigin
functions.description: Sets the default crop origin (top-left) in pixels as rationals.
requirements: origin values should be within the raw image bounds when combined with the crop size.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetDefaultCropOrigin
functions.description: Convenience overload to set default crop origin using integer pixel coordinates.
requirements: originH and originV should be within the image bounds when combined with the crop size.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetDefaultCropCentered
functions.description: Centers the default crop rectangle within the given raw image size.
requirements: rawSize.h and rawSize.v must be at least as large as the current default crop size to avoid negative origins.

functions.name: dng_negative::DefaultCropOriginH
functions.description: Returns the default crop horizontal origin as a rational.

functions.name: dng_negative::DefaultCropOriginV
functions.description: Returns the default crop vertical origin as a rational.

functions.name: dng_negative::DefaultUserCropT
functions.description: Returns the top coordinate of the default user crop in relative coordinates (0..1).

functions.name: dng_negative::DefaultUserCropL
functions.description: Returns the left coordinate of the default user crop in relative coordinates (0..1).

functions.name: dng_negative::DefaultUserCropB
functions.description: Returns the bottom coordinate of the default user crop in relative coordinates (0..1).

functions.name: dng_negative::DefaultUserCropR
functions.description: Returns the right coordinate of the default user crop in relative coordinates (0..1).

functions.name: dng_negative::ResetDefaultUserCrop
functions.description: Resets the default user crop to cover the full image (T=0, L=0, B=1, R=1).

functions.name: dng_negative::SetDefaultUserCrop
functions.signature: void dng_negative::SetDefaultUserCrop (const dng_urational &t, const dng_urational &l, const dng_urational &b, const dng_urational &r)
functions.description: Sets all four coordinates of the default user crop in relative coordinates.
requirements: t, l, b, r should be in [0,1] with t <= b and l <= r.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetDefaultUserCropT
functions.description: Sets the top coordinate of the default user crop.
requirements: value should be in [0,1] and not exceed the bottom coordinate.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetDefaultUserCropL
functions.description: Sets the left coordinate of the default user crop.
requirements: value should be in [0,1] and not exceed the right coordinate.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetDefaultUserCropB
functions.description: Sets the bottom coordinate of the default user crop.
requirements: value should be in [0,1] and be >= the top coordinate.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetDefaultUserCropR
functions.description: Sets the right coordinate of the default user crop.
requirements: value should be in [0,1] and be >= the left coordinate.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetDefaultScale
functions.description: Sets the default pixel scale factors (horizontal and vertical) used for pixel aspect ratio and downstream size calculations.

functions.name: dng_negative::DefaultScaleH
functions.description: Returns the default horizontal pixel scale factor.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid only while the dng_negative instance remains alive and unmodified in ways that would invalidate internals.

functions.name: dng_negative::DefaultScaleV
functions.description: Returns the default vertical pixel scale factor.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid only while the dng_negative instance remains alive and unmodified in ways that would invalidate internals.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetBestQualityScale
functions.description: Sets the best-quality overall scale multiplier used for computing best-quality final dimensions.

functions.name: dng_negative::BestQualityScale
functions.description: Returns the best-quality scale multiplier.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid only while the dng_negative instance remains alive.

functions.name: dng_negative::RawToFullScaleH
functions.description: Returns the horizontal mapping scale from raw sensor coordinates to the full (stage 3) image coordinates.

functions.name: dng_negative::RawToFullScaleV
functions.description: Returns the vertical mapping scale from raw sensor coordinates to the full (stage 3) image coordinates.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetRawToFullScale
functions.description: Sets the mapping scales from raw sensor coordinates to full (stage 3) image coordinates.

functions.name: dng_negative::DefaultScale
functions.description: Returns a single default scale factor (the horizontal default scale), used for convenience in size computations.

functions.name: dng_negative::SquareWidth
functions.description: Returns the default cropped image width at scale 1.0.

functions.name: dng_negative::SquareHeight
functions.description: Returns the default cropped image height at scale 1.0, adjusted for pixel aspect ratio (DefaultScaleV/DefaultScaleH).

functions.name: dng_negative::AspectRatio
functions.description: Returns the default cropped image aspect ratio (width/height) at scale 1.0.

functions.name: dng_negative::PixelAspectRatio
functions.description: Returns the pixel aspect ratio of the stage 3 image derived from default and raw-to-full scales.

functions.name: dng_negative::FinalWidth
functions.description: Returns the default cropped image width at the provided output scale (rounded to uint32).

functions.name: dng_negative::FinalHeight
functions.description: Returns the default cropped image height at the provided output scale (rounded to uint32).

functions.name: dng_negative::DefaultFinalWidth
functions.description: Returns the default cropped image width at the default scale.

functions.name: dng_negative::DefaultFinalHeight
functions.description: Returns the default cropped image height at the default scale.

functions.name: dng_negative::BestQualityFinalWidth
functions.description: Returns the default cropped image width at best-quality scale.

functions.name: dng_negative::BestQualityFinalHeight
functions.description: Returns the default cropped image height at best-quality scale.

functions.name: dng_negative::OriginalDefaultFinalSize
functions.description: Returns the cached default final size (width,height) for the original non-proxy image.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid only while the dng_negative instance remains alive.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetOriginalDefaultFinalSize
functions.description: Sets the cached default final size (width,height) for the original non-proxy image.

functions.name: dng_negative::OriginalBestQualityFinalSize
functions.description: Returns the cached best-quality final size for the original non-proxy image.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid only while the dng_negative instance remains alive.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetOriginalBestQualityFinalSize
functions.description: Sets the cached best-quality final size for the original non-proxy image.

functions.name: dng_negative::OriginalDefaultCropSizeH
functions.description: Returns the original (non-proxy) default crop size horizontal component.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid only while the dng_negative instance remains alive.

functions.name: dng_negative::OriginalDefaultCropSizeV
functions.description: Returns the original (non-proxy) default crop size vertical component.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid only while the dng_negative instance remains alive.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetOriginalDefaultCropSize
functions.description: Sets the cached original (non-proxy) default crop size (horizontal and vertical).

functions.name: dng_negative::SetDefaultOriginalSizes
functions.description: If the cached original-size fields are undefined, initializes them to the current default/best-quality sizes.

functions.name: dng_negative::DefaultCropArea
functions.description: Computes the default crop rectangle in stage 3 image coordinates.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetBaselineNoise
functions.description: Sets the baseline noise metric for the camera (stored as a rational).

functions.name: dng_negative::BaselineNoiseR
functions.description: Returns the baseline noise as a rational value.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid only while the dng_negative instance remains alive.

functions.name: dng_negative::BaselineNoise
functions.description: Returns the baseline noise as a real64 value.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetNoiseReductionApplied
functions.description: Sets the amount of noise reduction already applied (0.0 to 1.0 typical; 0/0 for unknown).

functions.name: dng_negative::NoiseReductionApplied
functions.description: Returns the amount of noise reduction already applied (rational).
requirements: Returned reference remains valid only while the dng_negative instance remains alive.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetNoiseProfile
functions.description: Sets the noise profile describing per-plane noise characteristics.

functions.name: dng_negative::HasNoiseProfile
functions.description: Returns true if a valid noise profile is present for this negative (validated against plane count).

functions.name: dng_negative::NoiseProfile
functions.description: Returns the noise profile object.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid only while the dng_negative instance remains alive.

functions.name: dng_negative::SetBaselineExposure
functions.description: Sets the baseline exposure compensation (stored as a rational).

functions.name: dng_negative::BaselineExposureR
functions.description: Returns the baseline exposure as a signed rational value.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid only while the dng_negative instance remains alive.

functions.name: dng_negative::BaselineExposure

functions.name: dng_negative::TotalBaselineExposure
functions.description: Computes total baseline exposure, summing the negative's baseline exposure with the profile’s BaselineExposureOffset for the specified profile ID.
